Build a three-way crosswalk: (1) theories/becoming/chapters/THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md (1,897 lines, especially 'The theory stated in full', 'Part I stated whole' at roughly lines 1131-1327, §6.15, §8 open programme and the §9 module table); (2) the 229 records (fields statement/claim, laws, hypotheses, does_not_show, canonical_source, references[].declarations, proof_bindings); (3) the spine modules and check_becoming.py CORE/BRIDGE lists; (4) the package README experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/README.md and theories/becoming/results/GENERATIVITY-CHAIN.md.

Known starting facts (verify): a substring scan finds 60 record ids never mentioned in the chapter, 18 of them with canonical_source on the spine: continuous-time-as-tower, counts-exist-where-decided, every-origin-passes-the-gate, how-loops-form, imbalance-as-relatum, laws-at-coarser-steps, laws-at-finer-units, lifting-where-branching-is-finite, orders-as-a-sum-over-histories, recurrence-without-decidedness, recurrence-without-premise, recurring-reference-revision, selection-through-a-model-of-the-options, timely-response-necessity, two-act-worlds-carry-the-difference, what-a-finite-history-refutes, where-a-move-is-formed, worlds-are-runs; plus 9 Markdown-sourced assessments/arguments and 33 periphery records. (c) Do the §9 table and the package README list the same modules, layers and theorem counts as the receipt (spine_modules, core_modules, bridge_modules, per-module theorems)? areas.summary:
This area holds the evaluative half of the canonical chapter. §6 (lines 696–1130, about 147 KB) covers G0's content, its minimality, the correspondence readings, reasons, comparison, the restatement from 'what wants its continuation' (6.7) and the one axiom `Unrestricted` (6.8). It goes on to route (b) without the axiom (6.9), feedback and reach (6.10), the decomposition of the axiom into presupposition plus invariance (6.11), the audit of G0's uses (6.12), the generative space (6.13), regrouping (6.14) and the conditional section 6.15 created by P128. 'Part I stated whole' (lines 1131–1327, about 108 KB, roughly 420 cited declarations) is the theory-wide summary: what holds of every unfolding, what each premise adds, where the dynamics stop deciding, and how evaluation holds for any significance. The section is backed by the core Lean modules Metaethics, Standpoints, Continuation, Significance, Interdependence, Feedback, Boundaries, Relevance, Regions, Ranking and Regrouping (all core; receipt becoming-verification.json passed 20261016T124157Z; fresh I5 run on d21b311a, 703 steps, empty core axiom report). It also draws on 30 result records, DELEGATED-CHOICES D1–D39, PART-II-INVENTORY and the 2.4 MB study BECOMING-RENEWAL-READING.md.

Condition. All 617 backticked identifiers in the range resolve to existing declarations, namespaces or modules; the misses are witness namespaces such as Clearing, the periphery module OpenFutureRevision, and variables. All 121 links resolve. More than 40 declarations were spot-checked against the prose, and most paraphrases match their hypotheses. The fold is clean in substance: no sentence asserts Ren's 'one step' or `Unrestricted`. Every use is conditional, and 6.15 says outright that the theory does not assert it. Lean docstrings (Significance.lean header, Relevance.lean) agree.

What needs work:
(1) Stale wording from before the fold. A global patch tells readers that 'under the axiom' means 'with the axiom as a condition'. Other phrases are also out of date: 'Before Ren decides … Part II', 'the replacement', 'G0 is now a theorem of this axiom'.
(2) A stale count. 6.15 says 22 Part I theorems take the condition; that number is the 11-October inventory's, scoped to old Part II. The core now has at least 26 such theorems, including the three equivalences that 6.15 itself cites.
(3) A zh/en contradiction in 6.3 about who decided the reading of 生生.
(4) The headline characterization conflates the Seed with S0.
(5) Several results are definitional but are presented as laws or discoveries. 'C is a law' on level paths, the 'axiom is needed' claim, and the decomposition (which has the form axiom ⇔ P ∧ (P → axiom)) are definitional. So is everything taken under `Unrestricted`, which sets significance to the constant ⊤. The prose admits some of this ('immediate', 'locates the step'), but the headings overstate.
(6) Readings later superseded or withdrawn are kept in the body: 6.7 reads the axiom as N_std, and 6.9 gives a reading followed by its correction.
(7) Parity: the English of 6.1–6.6 and 6.14 is a summary, not a translation.
(8) Bloat: 47 delegation boilerplates, review-history narration, a dated status paragraph in 6.13, and a 'stated whole' with bullets of up to 3,669 characters that is better generated as a catalogue.

proved.claim: G0 characterization: on a connected valuation with some living claim, G0 at claim level (every living claim significant from every standpoint) is equivalent to a Seed together with N_rel and N_std.
proved.conditions: Connected V; a living claim c₀; a standpoint p₀. Neutral rule := ∀ i, rule i.
proved.assessment: Correct but shallow. The forward direction is immediate, and the backward direction is induction along Reach. The zh prose admits this at line 715; the en prose omits it. The chapter wrongly calls the Seed 'S0' (lines 713, 717).

proved.claim: Minimality: dropping the seed, N_rel, N_std, connection or A each leaves a consistent countermodel, and each rival is the same rule inside a formed boundary.
proved.conditions: Small finite models (two standpoints, three lives).
proved.assessment: Substantive as independence witnesses. 'Every rival accepts the same rule inside a boundary' follows from the Within/Neutral definitions and is a framing, not a theorem. §6.2 cites none of these declarations.

proved.claim: Where every living claim is held, G0 is S0 at every standpoint plus N_std, with no connection or N_rel. A second completion is S0 plus N_rel on a connected whole. Along dependence, the center is not derived (Clearing).
proved.conditions: Held, or decidable holding with reachability; witness webs.
proved.assessment: Correct, and modest. The proofs are short, and center_not_derived is a concrete witness with substantive content. The prose matches.

proved.claim: Derived extent with no ethical premise: under balance and dissipation, an enclosed finite family whose taking recurs cannot be unfed from beyond from some step on; joint excess is bounded and ends the renewers that depend on it; the extent runs one way.
proved.conditions: Balances, Dissipative, DecidableEq C, Distinct list, enclosure from T₀. fed_from_beyond is stated in negative form (¬ ∀ t ≥ N, ¬ FedFromBeyond).
proved.assessment: These are dynamics results with real accounting content, and the most substantive part of 6.7. They belong with the Part I dynamics, not inside the superseded 'restatement' framing.

proved.claim: Under the condition `Unrestricted` (significance ≡ ⊤ for every standpoint, step and formation), G0, S0 everywhere, both neutralities and a seed hold; retaining is inclusion and adding is exceeding; widening/keeping/mixed are retaining-and-adding, retaining both ways, adding both ways; positive relevance from significance is the least G0-satisfying relevance.
proved.conditions: Unrestricted sig as an explicit hypothesis, plus the correspondence `reads` (claim significance is a formation's continuation significance). The theory does not assert the condition (§6.15).
proved.assessment: Definitional. Unrestricted makes significance the constant ⊤, so each result unfolds definitions in one to three lines. The chapter says 'the step is immediate' (862/877), and 6.15 says the condition 'adds no rule'. These statements are honest; the headings are louder than the content.

proved.claim: The axiom is G0 for anything: on frames whose claims are formations at steps, realized somewhere (including every web's level paths), Unrestricted is equivalent to G0 with every claim living and positive relevance read as significance from every standpoint.
proved.conditions: Every claim is realized at some configuration (Web.paths_somewhere).
proved.assessment: Correct and definitional. It shows that the condition is only a widening of G0's scope, as the prose says.

proved.claim: Not harm as an exact margin boundary: with a part withheld, the levels with it retain what has significance exactly when its cumulative net draw stays within the margin, for any significance; local forms need balance only where used. Widening has the same boundary.

proved.assessment: Substantive accounting identities that hold for any significance; 6.15 calls them 'arithmetic', which is accurate. Reading them as Ren's 'phase transition with a clear boundary' is the AI's interpretation.

proved.claim: C on level paths with 'better' read as widening holds for every reading of living, with no axiom ('C is a law').
proved.conditions: Level paths frame; Better := Widens.
proved.assessment: Definitional. Comparison only requires Extension ⇒ Better, and Widens is Extension with every claim living, so the proof is two lines. C's normative content is not discharged; it is moved into calling widening 'better'. The prose 'C is a law, not a premise' overstates.

proved.claim: Comparison within reach: any significance covering what a part has reached before each step compares that part as inclusion (the axiom's comparison); feedback registers at most the influence closure.
proved.conditions: Balance; WithheldLevels; the adding comparisons hold only up to double negation unless significance is decidable.
proved.assessment: Substantive locality results. This is the real general form behind the conditional theorems, as the inventory notes. The prose matches.

proved.claim: Route (b), without the axiom: what a continuation depends on is its feeding closure; consumption ends with its feeders; inside the closure a loss can return (Overshoot), beyond it it need not (Clearing).
proved.conditions: Balance, Acting, Dependent; witness webs.
proved.assessment: Dynamics results with content. 'Selection between wholes keeps the wholes that continue' and 'neither mechanism reaches a loss that returns to no one' are AI readings over two witnesses; no general selection theorem exists.

proved.claim: Decomposition of the axiom: where the whole is admissible, the axiom is equivalent to the presupposition being sub-true and boundary-invariant at every standpoint. Invariance is exactly the conditional from the presupposition to the axiom, and given covering and the presupposition it is N_std's rule.
proved.conditions: Admissible boundaries are the regions closed under a relation (the whole is always admissible).
proved.assessment: A correct logical identity of the form A ⇔ P ∧ (P → A). It locates the contested step and derives nothing; the record says 'does not compel the step'. The literature placement (Nagel, Gewirth, Parfit, Sidgwick) is argued, not formal.

proved.claim: The universal reason: a sound inquiry for new living content gives every position with access a contributory reason (from Grounds, connection and A); under the condition, no Seed, N_rel, N_std or connection premise is needed if A is read on living content.
proved.conditions: A (Neutral articulates / articulatesLiving) is a hypothesis; soundness; correspondence `reads`.
proved.assessment: These pass premises through to conclusions. The normative content is in A and Grounds. 'No neutrality premise' (1009/1124) is inaccurate, because A is itself a Neutral premise.

proved.claim: Comparison of courses on possibilities ranks absence of an overdrawing formation, restraint and sharing above their rivals and withholds no event; it leaves presence vs absence of a within-renewal formation unranked.
proved.conditions: The support-gated two-formation family Ranking.Law (needG, needF, renew, contrib, draw); possible_extends_iff also takes Unrestricted.
proved.assessment: Correct finite-family computations. Adopting this comparison is the AI's decision (D1). Its first rationale ('the axiom's own comparison') is conditional now that P128 is in place.

proved.claim: Significance is not decided by the dynamics: on any web with a living event, G0 holds under sig ≡ ⊤ and fails under sig ≡ ⊥.
proved.conditions: A living (active, not undermining) event.
proved.assessment: Trivial, but it makes the right point. The heading 'The axiom is needed' overstates: G0 also follows from the weaker premises of §6.1 and §6.7.

proved.claim: Counting laws under the eight premises: under the 256 selections the laws of counting are of two kinds (three in finite worlds); binding adds only that something arises; no finite world binds every premise; the eight premises are independent.
proved.conditions: Decidable activity; Pointwise properties of counts. Independence holds among separately chosen readings, and several witnesses meet the flow premises vacuously (Premises.lean header).
proved.assessment: Substantive and well scoped. The prose matches, apart from citing World.contingent, which covers seven predicates including Carried.

proved.claim: Rest and openness: a balanced, dissipative, embodied world with censuses that is enclosed from some step cannot be refuted to come to rest; arising without end needs openness, including with refinement counted; naming the end step gives LPO; asking that arising recurs exactly when ceasing does gives excluded middle.
proved.conditions: Counted, StandingCensus, ArisingEmbodied, Balanced, Dissipative, enclosure from T. The rest conclusion is ¬¬∃N.
proved.assessment: Substantive constructive results. The prose says 'comes to rest' (1177/1275), where Lean gives only 'cannot be refuted to rest'.

proved.claim: Laws of change, learning and contextuality in 'stated whole' I: within finite configurations lossless ⇔ every configuration returns; the parity obstruction gives context-free assignment or contradiction (Specker, CHSH, Mermin–Peres); exact identification and learner bounds (2N−1, cubic refutation learner); exact typicality spread; carried difference attained.
proved.where: Recurrence.lean:439; Gluing.lean:465; Identification.lean:1525; Typicality.lean:305; Propagation.lean:886; Frequency.lean:807
proved.conditions: Finite lists of configurations, DecidableEq where stated, Distinct claims, balanced flows for Propagation.
proved.assessment: Substantive, and the spot-checked paraphrases are exact: (N³−N)/4 matches (2m+3)(m+1)(m+2). change_readings, listed first, holds by Iff.rfl and is definitional; the section's caveat at 1142/1240 covers this.

proved.claim: Ethical direction: 生生 (realized living content) has significance from every standpoint (G0 holds).
proved.conditions: Holds only with Ren's proposed axiom (Unrestricted) as a condition, which the theory does not assert; A, C on general frames, L and J1–J4 remain disclosed premises; the normative warrant is open (§8).

proved.claim: Motivation without warrant (route b): a center that represents its closure has its own reason to retain what lies within it; selection between wholes keeps the wholes that continue; Ren's order of levels is an order of readings of the presupposition.

issues.title: Headline G0 characterization names the Seed 'S0'
issues.description: §6.1 states G0 ⇔ '种子 S0' plus N_rel and N_std (en: 'a seed (S0)'). In Lean, S0 is SelfGood, a premise at each position, while Seed is the weaker ∃ p c, living c ∧ sig p c. significant_iff characterizes G0 with Seed. The premise card and the record keep the two apart.

issues.verify_reason: In Lean, `SelfGood p` (docstring 'S0 at a position') is ∀ c, own p c → living c → sig p c, and `Seed` is ∃ p c, living c ∧ sig p c. `Grounds := Seed ∧ Neutral transmits ∧ Neutral shares`, and `significant_iff` characterizes Significant with Grounds, that is with Seed. Read literally with S0 = SelfGood, the chapter's 'G0 ⇔ 种子 S0 + N_rel + N_std' is false in the converse direction. SelfGood holds vacuously where no position owns a living claim, so S0 with N does not give a seed without an extra hypothesis (cf. `seed_of_selfGood`, which needs `own p c`). The record states it correctly ('种子；任何持 S0 且有自身生生的位置都提供一个'). Line 715's following sentence, 'everything beyond what an evaluator already holds lies in boundary neutrality', leans on the same conflation. The en (717) also lacks the zh's 'G0 ⇒ premises is nearly trivial' remark.

issues.title: 'C is a law, not a premise' on level paths is definitional
issues.description: Comparison only requires Extension ⇒ Better. With Better := Widens, which is Extension with every claim living, C holds by unfolding in two lines. The normative content of C ('the extension is better') is not discharged; it is moved into reading 'better' as widening. 6.13's own 'What it does not derive' admits that the 'ought' does not come along, but the headline and the stated whole call C a law.
issues.evidence: lines 1057, 1067, 1227, 1325; Metaethics.lean:275 (def Comparison); Regions.lean:151 (Widens := Includes ∧ Exceeds); Significance.lean:431–441 (paths_extension_iff_widens, paths_comparison_widens and docstring 'a law, not a premise')
issues.fix: Say 'C holds by definition once "better" is read as widening; whether widening is better is the open question of §8'. Drop 'law, not a premise' from the chapter and the Lean docstring (next core run).
issues.verify_reason: The core is right: `Web.paths_comparison_widens` is a pure unfolding. Comparison is Extension ⇒ Better, and with Better := Widens = Includes ∧ Exceeds the proof just repackages the extension's components. So it is definitional, and a 'proved' catalogue should label it so. But the overclaim is milder than stated. Every occurrence (1057, 1067, 1227, 1325) carries the qualifier 'with "better" read as widening' in the same sentence, and 6.13's 'What it does not derive' (1061/1071) explicitly says the 'ought' does not come along and is the open question of §8. The bold bullet titles 'C 是规律 / C is a law' and the Lean docstring phrase 'a law, not a premise' are the only unqualified parts. In repo usage, 'law' means a no-premise theorem, so this is a labelling and emphasis issue, not an unsupported result.
issues.corrected_fix: Retitle the bullets to e.g. 'C under the widening reading', and add 'this holds by unfolding the definitions'. Keep the existing pointer that whether widening is better is open (§8). Change the Lean docstring only in a batch that already reruns the core checker, not as a standalone edit.

areas.summary:
This area is the repository's front door: the root pages (README, RESEARCH, RESULTS, GOALS, DEPENDENCIES, OPEN-QUESTIONS, AGENTS), the Makefile/CI, the research config and workflow, and _process/architecture (the generated-page manifest, the history manifest and 99 hash-named snapshot directories, plus the 10-08 repair and 10-09 rename evidence). tools/research/navigation.py render_views (lines 204-285) writes 11 overview pages and registry.render_index writes a 12th. README.md is generated from theories/becoming/OPENING.md (Ren's text, AI footnotes) plus prose hardcoded at navigation.py:220 and four featured records. AGENTS.md, RESULT-WORKFLOW.md and the corpus-era MAP/BOOKS/GLOSSARY/TIMELINE are written by hand.

Condition: the mechanism works. `research.py check` at HEAD 0cfb9c567 passes: 0 errors, 0 drift, 440 style warnings over 125 records. Links in AGENTS, OPENING and RESULT-WORKFLOW resolve, the history hashes validate, and every one of the 85 record snapshots is referenced. The content of the pages lags the theory, and the renderer duplicates it heavily.

(1) The same 229-row register is written five times, about 350 KB: RESULTS, RESEARCH, theories/becoming/README, chapters/CLAIMS, RESULT-REGISTER. The goals are written twice (GOALS and ROADMAP).
(2) DEPENDENCIES.md is 555 KB: 587 edge sections that repeat each record page's own dependency section, with no "used by" index.
(3) README's "Leading results" are four G0/J/assessment records from before the unification, and only those four records have `overview` fields. None of the zero-premise spine laws is featured: only 7 of the 138 records whose source is in the Becoming package are linked from any goal.
(4) The Theory of Becoming "Next" step is the 11 October redirect, unchanged through P51–P130.
(5) AGENTS.md was last changed on 10-11. It still frames G0 as an adopted axiom route and sends newcomers to RESEARCH.md (a bare table) and BRIEF.md (boilerplate).
(6) CI is not running because of GitHub billing. Once billing is fixed it would still fail: with a shallow checkout and the history lookup disabled, 248 records report drift, so the check exits 2.
(7) The study index lists no study, although the main Becoming study is BECOMING-RENEWAL-READING.md (2.4 MB, §1–§165).
(8) The "Full reading catalogue" is dated 10-08 and never mentions the canonical chapter.
(9) Some README footnotes still say more than the Lean shows. The margin laws hold for every `sig` but are labelled "Proved under the one axiom". `change_readings` holds by six `Iff.rfl` steps. The README never says that `Unrestricted` is strictly stronger than G0.

No top-level page states theorem counts. The chapter's §9 counts (7,089 theorems) are behind the 16 October fresh run (7,214 theorems, 6,918 of them core). The history mechanism is sound but opaque: 12 MB, 14 view versions each kept twice (raw + reading edition), next to 85 record snapshots.

Proposed minimal top-level set:
- README: the opening, plus a generated "What is established" block with receipt counts and headline laws grouped by part, plus a start path.
- RESULTS: one register, grouped by chapter section and ring.
- OPEN-QUESTIONS: the targets, the chapter §8 programme and decisions waiting on Ren.
- GOALS: active directions first, closed scopes folded; it absorbs ROADMAP.
- AGENTS: the working rules, updated.
- DEPENDENCIES: compact, with upstream and downstream columns.

Everything else becomes a stub that keeps its old anchors, or moves to a history location. That includes RESEARCH, CLAIMS, the theory README table, RESULT-REGISTER, BRIEF, and (with Ren's go) the corpus-era pages.

issues.title: CI is not running, and a shallow checkout would make the drift check fail
issues.description: CI runs have been blocked by GitHub billing since 10-15 (release review §6: 54 of the last 60 runs never started). Restoring billing would not be enough. actions/checkout@v4 defaults to fetch-depth 1, and since f6816a74e (10-15) the drift check looks up each record's reviewed version in the git history of HEAD (registry.reviewed_version). With that lookup returning None, as it would in a depth-1 clone, validate() reports drift for 248 records, so research-check exits 2. RESULT-WORKFLOW.md:137 and _process/architecture/README.md:12 still say that GitHub Actions runs the checks.
issues.evidence: BECOMING-RELEASE-READINESS-REVIEW.md:88; development/i5-checker-reproducible/REPORT.md:81; tools/research/registry.py:46-80; simulation: python -B with registry.reviewed_version = lambda p,s: None -> drift 248 (normal run: 0)

issues.verify_reason: The workflow uses actions/checkout@v4 with no fetch-depth, so the clone has depth 1. registry.validate reports drift only when the bytes differ AND changed_lines cannot find the reviewed blob in HEAD's history ('(reviewed version not in history)', registry.py:138-139). A depth-1 clone holds no older blobs. Simulated read-only: normal validate gives 0 drift and 0 errors; with reviewed_version patched to return None it gives 248 drift entries across 158 records, so research-check exits 2. Correction to the wording: it is 248 drift entries over 158 records, not 248 records. CI not running since 10-15 is documented in the release review §6. RESULT-WORKFLOW.md:137 and architecture/README.md:12 still say GitHub Actions runs the checks.
issues.corrected_fix: As proposed: add `with: fetch-depth: 0`. Optionally make the checker tolerate a shallow clone by detecting it (git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository) and reporting unverifiable drift as a warning. Rewording the two docs and restoring billing are Ren's call.

issues.title: README footnotes credit the axiom and 'proof' with more than the Lean shows
issues.description: (a) [^good-evil] is headed 'Proved under the one axiom' and cites Flow.Balances.loses_iff_beyond_margin and adds_iff_within_margin. Both quantify over every `sig`, with no Unrestricted hypothesis (Significance.lean:328-344): the exact margin boundary holds for any significance, and the axiom only says that every continuation counts. (b) [^axiom] (README.md:68) never says that Unrestricted (Significance.lean:134, Neutral over all standpoints, steps and formations) is strictly stronger than G0 and makes significance constant. (c) [^law] (README.md:58) gives change_readings as 'Proved', but the proof is six Iff.rfl (Change.lean:548), i.e. a definition read three ways. The release review (§2, items 3, 4, 7) flagged these on 1a78f978, and they remain at HEAD. The footnotes are AI-written, but they sit in Ren's OPENING.md, so changes need Ren.
issues.evidence: README.md:58,68,76,94; experiments/.../lean/becoming/Becoming/Significance.lean:134,328-344; Change.lean:542-548; BECOMING-RELEASE-READINESS-REVIEW.md §2
issues.fix: Propose wording to Ren. [^good-evil]: 'The margin boundary is proved for any significance; under the axiom it applies to every continuation.' [^axiom]: add 'Unrestricted is stronger than G0: everything has significance from everywhere.' [^law]: 'holds by definition (`change_readings` is `rfl`)'.
issues.verify_reason: (a) Confirmed and sharper than stated. Flow.Balances.loses_iff_beyond_margin and adds_iff_within_margin (Significance.lean:328-344) quantify over every `sig` with no Unrestricted hypothesis, but they do require `L.Balances W` and `L.WithheldLevels part W l`. The heading 'Proved under the one axiom' therefore leaves out the balance premise and credits the axiom with the arithmetic. Under Unrestricted the sig conjunct is just dropped. (b) Weak as an overclaim. [^axiom] already states Unrestricted's content ('from every standpoint, the continuation of anything has significance at every step'), and Neutral is `∀ i, rule i` (Metaethics.lean:119), so sig is identically true. What it omits is the consequence the release review §2.7 and O2 stress: with sig constant, every closing loses (predation, apoptosis), and good is not told from evil without a further measure. (c) Confirmed: change_readings (Change.lean:542-548) is six .rfl, and its own docstring says 'by definition', yet [^law] lists it under 'Proved' beside keep_pace and law_iff_em. Release review items 1 and 4(README.md:102) have since been fixed. These footnotes are in theories/becoming/OPENING.md:54,64,72, which is edited only with Ren.
issues.corrected_fix: Propose wording to Ren; do not edit OPENING.md without Ren's go. [^good-evil]: 'Proved under balance for any significance; under the axiom, where every continuation counts, it reads: a part loses ... exactly where its net draw exceeds the margin.' [^axiom]: add 'Under it significance is constant, so every closing loses; telling good from evil needs a further measure.' [^law]: mark change_readings 'by definition (rfl)'.

areas.summary:
This area has three layers. (1) The September consolidation layer (2026-09-03 to 10-04): MAP.md (95 KB), GLOSSARY.md (189 KB), TIMELINE.md (79 KB), BOOKS.md (104 KB), _process/THEORY-DIGEST, THEORY-TEMPLATE, COVERAGE, CRITIQUE-FINDINGS, LOST-ARTIFACTS, timeline-raw.tsv, read-pass-1-plan.json and _process/reading-notes/ (21 files, 4.2 MB). Together they mapped the 15–17 pre-Becoming theory folders, their vocabulary with provenance markers, the history and a book plan. Apart from the 10-09 path-rename commit (87fdbb077), none has been substantively edited since 10-04. None describes the Theory of Becoming, the G0 fold, Part I or the pure Lean core. (2) The 10-07 handoff layer: CLOUD-HANDOFF-2026-10-07 and nine _process/handoffs/ files. They are dated session handoffs whose merges have already been done (1fe1c2d1a, f0fc8818f). By policy they kept their pre-rename paths, so they carry 6 broken links. (3) The live governance layer: _process/BRIEF.md (a generated reading guide), _process/goals/*.json (15 scoped goals that generate GOALS.md and README's 'Ongoing research'), and _process/RESEARCH-DIRECTIVES.md (70 KB, 61 paragraphs, the register of Ren's directives).

Condition. The historical documents are valuable evidence: provenance-marked Ren/AI vocabulary, Ren-voice material, the reading-pass record. But four are still presented as current. Every generated view links MAP.md as the 'Broader theory map' (navigation.py:275), and its Becoming row and 'What to do next' list are stale. GLOSSARY.md calls itself 'the canonical vocabulary of the corpus'. In fact the canonical vocabulary is chapter §10, which binds 192 terms to Lean. Only 1 of 192 headwords matches exactly. The same characters (开/闭 against 开放/封闭/锁定) carry normative senses in GLOSSARY and technical senses in §10, with no crosswalk between them. GLOSSARY also has stale meta-attractor 'unreconciled/rename' notes. 14 pointers in these documents to sections of OPEN-QUESTIONS.md now land on a generated register of records. Some proof claims about the SSBX Lean (0 sorry/0 axioms; type-level 反诛心) are stated as fact, but no SSBX Lean source exists in this repository.

The governance layer is mostly consistent with AGENTS: the first priority is Theory of Becoming, the G0 route keeps its scope, and the P128 fold appears in both the register and the theory-of-becoming goal. Its structure, however, has drifted:
- Goals have no lifecycle status. The completed meta-attractor session, superseded goals (generative-foundation, normative-grounding) and three goals with no records are rendered as if they were live directions, against Ren's 10-08 instruction 「其他的搞定了就不要作为方向了」.
- GOALS.md is sorted alphabetically, so the first priority is section 11 of 15.
- The first-priority goal links 9 of 229 records. The README's 'Established results' and 'Next' therefore leave out the Part I core line (P40–P130).
- The register has one heading and no anchors, its entries are in mixed order, and it does not mark entries superseded by the 10-16 fold. It also does not link at least 6 goal-defining authorizations, although AGENTS says it holds all of them.

Restructure direction:
- Rewrite MAP and GLOSSARY as short current pages (corpus map; crosswalk to §10), with full originals preserved in history.
- Move the September bundle and the 10-07 handoffs to dated history folders with manifests.
- Reindex the register by dated anchors with supersession marks.
- Add a status field to goals and render first priority, then active, dormant and completed.

areas.summary:
Lines 1–695 of the canonical chapter hold 402,947 bytes, about 42% of the 962 KB file, in 695 physical lines. Many lines are single paragraphs of 4–12 KB; line 110 alone is 12.4 KB. Byte counts by part: header and "In one sentence" 7.6 KB; "The theory stated in full" 71.8 KB; premise card 7.1 KB; §1 69.6 KB; §2 153.6 KB; §3 80.7 KB; §4 3.6 KB; §5 7.1 KB.

**Citations and claims.** Every one of the 1,061 backticked identifiers cited in this range resolves to a source declaration. The breakdown:
- 920 core declarations and 64 core modules;
- 67 core namespaces (witness worlds such as `Accretion`, `Tandem`, `Clearing`) or structure fields;
- 10 foundation or periphery names.

All 373 markdown links resolve. I read about 60 cited statements in the Lean source. Most prose matches its theorem: for example `World.law_iff_em`, `counting_under`, `most_difference_arrives`, `Law.sameFuture_iff_classes`, `Identification.learner_rest_cubic`, `Typicality.spread` and `significant_iff_held`. The Ren quotations I sampled match their sources. The existing receipt (fresh run on d21b311a: 703 steps, `core_axioms: []`) supports the empty-axiom claim for the core.

**Main problems.** They are structural, plus a cluster of status and parity errors.
1. **Inverted summary.** "The theory stated in full" cites 196 identifiers. 172 of them appear nowhere in the §1–§5 body, so this "summary" is the main home of the results on premises, counting, rest and enclosure. The same content is restated in §1 "The whole and its parts" and again in "Part I stated whole" (lines 1131–1328, 108 KB).
2. **§2 has absorbed landings by date.** It now contains response, counterfactual and tail (22.7 KB) and the whole propagation, loops and frequency cluster of 16 October (62 KB).
3. **Session narration.** The range carries 88 ISO dates outside link targets, 72 English dates, 78 delegation formulas, 33 study-§ links, a P-number, a commit hash, a dated heading and post-hoc "after 16 October" patches.
4. **Status-category blurring.** "Law (no premise)" covers results that assume finiteness, decidability, local balance or listing.
5. **Premise card is incomplete and stale.** It names none of the eight `World` premises and still presents `Generative.Process` as a law supplied from outside.
6. **Unlabelled periphery results.** Periphery results, some depending on Classical.choice or on Mathlib with Lean 4.30.0-rc2, sit unlabelled inside "Part I: Without axiom".
7. **Contradictions.** Two are zh/en contradictions (the 生/生生 readings, the holding readings). The others: whether decidedness is a representation commitment; whether `World` is the starting point; which proposition is "the one axiom"; a stale list of open items.
8. **Opening frames a definitional result as a substantive theorem.** It says G0 "is a theorem" under the axiom. In Lean, `Unrestricted sig` is `∀ p t f, sig p t f`, so G0 follows by unfolding definitions; line 686 says this honestly, the opening does not.
9. **Bilingual parity fails.** Several zh blocks have no English. The English paragraphs of §3 drop all Lean citations.

**Suggested rewrite.** Make the opening one real sentence. Add a status table and a complete premise card. Give each subsection one claim–conditions–declarations–status–reading paragraph per language, with D-IDs in place of dated delegation prose. Move the detailed theorem catalogues to generated per-topic law tables built from the records. Add a new section for causation and propagation. Target size is roughly 110–140 KB for this range, 25–35% of the current size, with nothing deleted: git commit 0cfb9c56 keeps the current text, and a history note can point to it.

proved.claim: Laws of change by definition and arithmetic: arising and ceasing, forming and dissolving, and coming to stand and ceasing to stand are one change read three ways. Over any stretch, end amount plus falls equals start amount plus rises. In a finite family with decided determinations, comings and ceasings differ by at most the number of members and recur together.
proved.conditions: keep_pace and coming_recurs_iff take [∀ a t, Decidable (p a t)] and a finite list; standing needs no decision because levels are in Nat
proved.assessment: change_readings is Iff.rfl, a definition; the rest are elementary counting identities. The prose describes them accurately as 'identities' and 'arithmetic identities'.

proved.claim: The finite-world law equals excluded middle: in a finite world with decided activity, arising recurs exactly when ceasing does. Asked of every finite world without decidability, the law is equivalent to excluded middle. With infinitely many relata the two separate (accretion, attrition).
proved.conditions: w.Finite and decidable activity
proved.assessment: A substantive constructive metalogical result. The prose matches, but it labels this a 'law (no premise)' although finiteness and decidability are hypotheses. The Lean docstrings of law_decides and arising_iff_ceasing also disagree on whether decidability belongs to the representation.

proved.claim: A bounded count suffices for the law: with at most B relata active at each step and listed, arising recurs exactly when ceasing does. If the count grows without bound, however slowly, only ceasing needs arising.
proved.conditions: Decidable activity; listing within B
proved.assessment: Substantive within the model; the prose matches.

proved.claim: The tally is the whole law of counting: the counts of a listing are exactly the tallies, every tally is realized by a queue, and an extensional property of counts holds of every listing exactly when it holds of every tally.
proved.conditions: Pointwise Q (invariance under pointwise-equal functions, needed because funext is not available axiom-free); decidable predicate
proved.assessment: A complete, elementary combinatorial characterization. The prose does not mention the Pointwise restriction.

proved.claim: The premises are contingent and independent. Seven premises are each met and failed by some world; the eight premises of the map are mutually independent; hatch meets all eight with each binding; no finite world binds every premise. With the rest counted, balance, Acting and Taking hold by reading, and Dependent holds for laws of exchange.
proved.conditions: Witness worlds (shuttle, strained, unbalanced, scatter, morsel, lossless, latent, multitude, novel, hatch)
proved.assessment: Model-theoretic independence of separately chosen World fields, proved by countermodels. The chapter itself says this measures the freedom of the fields, not contingency in becoming.

proved.claim: Counting under each of the 256 premise selections takes one of two forms: the tally, or the tally plus 'nothing arises at a step at which nothing is active'. The second holds exactly where balance and embodiment are selected together with either only-active-giving, or with taking and dissipation. In finite worlds there are three forms; enclosure adds a change bound exactly where balance, embodiment and dissipation are selected.
proved.conditions: Pointwise Q; decidable activity; queue and ring witnesses
proved.assessment: A substantive exhaustive classification, but of a narrow object (the count, ceasing and arising sequences). The prose is faithful but enormous: one 12 KB line per language.

proved.claim: Rest theorem: in a world with censuses of what is active and what stands, embodied arising, balance, dissipation and enclosure from some step on, that the world rests cannot be refuted. Naming the rest step implies LPO. Each hypothesis is needed. Exchange stops without needing the activity census.
proved.conditions: Stated hypotheses; conclusion only in the form ¬¬∃N, RestsFrom N
proved.assessment: Substantive. The prose at lines 277/281 says 'comes to rest' without 'unrefuted'; line 77 hedges via the glossary.

proved.claim: Enclosure bounds change: from step T on, active relata plus steps with arising or ceasing number at most the total standing at T. A change bound from some step is one from step 0, and within a change bound nothing recurs.
proved.conditions: Census; all relata embodied; balance; dissipation; enclosure
proved.assessment: Substantive; the prose matches.

proved.claim: Unity of readings: with the rest of the whole counted as a relatum, every world balances and is one run of the law of exchange, and its former balance is exactly that the rest is never active. The contextual readings of one unfolding always form a world, and a context-free description exists exactly where the readings glue.
proved.conditions: None beyond the representation
proved.assessment: Largely a constructive re-reading: balance becomes bookkeeping of the rest (DELEGATED-CHOICES.md:473 says so). Correct but close to definitional.

proved.claim: Law and history: the law a history shows is determined exactly where the history is consistent. A family of histories is a law's family exactly where it holds its splices. Two laws have the same histories exactly where their live steps agree. Determined frames are alike exactly where they pass the same tests.
proved.conditions: None, or determinacy up to likeness where stated
proved.assessment: Elementary but exact. Bisimulation and test results are classical facts reproved constructively.

proved.claim: Attraction and runs: a configuration is drawn into an absorbing region exactly when it does not return. Of two merged configurations, not both escape being drawn (double negation only). A run from every member of every family that keeps moving, demanded of every process, is exactly dependent choice.
proved.conditions: Determined law for attraction; every process for Onward
proved.assessment: The chapter correctly calls the main attraction law 'close to definitional'. The equivalence with dependent choice is substantive.

proved.claim: Renewal and consumption belong to runs: renewing excludes consuming; one process with one start has a renewing run and a consuming run; consumption is exactly a dependence that never returns; an observable that never rises from step T on does not fall at arbitrarily late steps.
proved.conditions: Witness process for class_belongs_to_the_run
proved.assessment: A mix of witness constructions and elementary lemmas. The prose is faithful. The finite-horizon undecidability is in record becoming-finite-horizon.

proved.claim: Generation needs replenishment: in a balanced flow, uptake at arbitrarily late steps needs replenishment at arbitrarily late steps. With a census, distinct presence and taking, more without end gives unceasing generation. Under dissipation a recurring embodied generation in a distinct finite family keeps the family open. A rise comes with a fall in the same exchange.
proved.where: Flow.lean:495; Population.lean:1358; Roles.lean:708; Dissipation.lean:741, :796; chapter lines 329–339
proved.conditions: Balance (also for rise_with_fall), dissipation, Distinct where stated
proved.assessment: Elementary Nat inequalities with honest scope. Item 4 omits balance for rise_with_fall.

proved.claim: Admission and parts: the support boundary is exact (need plus the part's cumulative take is at most the withheld level plus the part's cumulative give). Support is gained only from the supported. The four relations Widens, Keeps, Mixed and narrowing exclude one another without classical logic.
proved.conditions: Balance; withheld levels exist
proved.assessment: An exact accounting identity; the substance lies in the reading that 'possibilities' means what can form next (Ren confirmed this reading).

proved.claim: Feeding, feedback and reach: unfed consumption ends within the condition's starting level. Feeding closure lies within influence closure, which lies within the system. The comparison with and without a part is decided within what the part reaches. Under a common fed condition, significance bounded by feeding closure is the axiom.
proved.conditions: Balance, Acting, Dependent; a covering significance
proved.assessment: Substantive within the flow model; the prose matches the hypotheses.

proved.claim: The counterfactual is the course: when the rest follows one law of what has stood, two balanced flows with the same act agree everywhere. The response premise of Becoming.Response follows when the law reads through registration.
proved.conditions: Nonanticipating law; balance; finitely many conditions for sensitivity
proved.assessment: Substantive. It turns a supplied premise into a theorem; the prose matches.

proved.claim: Least registration and omniscience: for laws over conditions numbered by Nat, a counterexample to 'sensitivity is the least registration' exists exactly where a rule decides, for every Boolean sequence, whether it is false throughout. The decision of vanishing is the LPO rule.
proved.conditions: Conditions numbered by Nat
proved.assessment: A substantive reverse-mathematics-style equivalence; the prose matches.

proved.claim: Propagation and loops: the carried amount is the most difference that can arrive (a sharp, attained equivalence). With stationary strengths it is bounded by a polynomial exactly where no loop lies upstream. Cutting the expansion at a finite order loses an exact, attained remainder. Coupling frequency sets the runaway rate, and 'every schedule settles' is equivalent to RecursOrStops, which gives LPO.
proved.where: Propagation.lean:886; Loops.lean:733, :1509; Remainder.lean; Frequency.lean:464, :602, :942; chapter lines 479–509
proved.conditions: Supplied Nat coupling strengths; every condition listed and Distinct (most_difference_arrives); stationarity for polynomial_iff_no_loop
proved.assessment: Substantive and sharp within a linear Nat-valued model with given strengths; real amounts and spectral radius are honestly left open. The prose is very long and contains post-hoc revision notes.

proved.claim: Knowing through registration: a claim is refuted only through a registered difference. A record fixes a move only where it was taken. A projection carries a law exactly where alike configurations go alike. A policy through registration cannot see the distance to a break. Seeking rests with its target met exactly at a fixed point that meets the target.
proved.where: Testing.lean; Experiment.lean:85; Mechanism.lean:117; Runaway.lean; Seeking.lean:137; chapter lines 529–551
proved.conditions: Determinacy where stated; the rest held fixed or responding
proved.assessment: Mostly elementary but exact; the interpretive weight sits in the readings (AI, delegated). The English paragraphs drop all declaration names.

proved.claim: Learning and identification: no record fixes the next value. Two histories with at most N and N′ states that agree before N+N′−1 agree everywhere (Fine–Wilf). Moore's bound N−1 holds for one world. The learner that uses the least bound is right from step 2N−1, which is optimal, while learning by refutation rests only at a cubic step. A target is learnable exactly where configurations with the same registered future eventually share target values. At a parting of runs no learner is right on both.
proved.where: Learning.lean; Identification.lean:342, :1525, :1674; Learnable.lean:233; Parting.lean:635; chapter lines 570–604
proved.conditions: Bounds on states; a list holds the world; decided values for Moore's bound
proved.assessment: Known results from automata and combinatorics, reproved constructively, plus genuinely new sharp statements (the cubic lower bound, optimality of 2N−1). The prose matches the statements.

proved.claim: Typicality and situations: weighted squared deviations sum exactly to n·p·q·(p+q)^n, giving a counting law of large numbers, and a Chernoff-type counting bound holds. Natural weights equal numbers of situations under a determined finer law.
proved.conditions: Natural-number weights; two values or an event
proved.assessment: Elementary exact counting identities. The prose honestly says that 'which course happens' is not derived.

proved.claim: Diagonal and contextuality: no registration indexed by what it reads says every reading (Lawvere). Specker's boxes and the Mermin–Peres square have no global assignment, and nine two-qubit observables admit no context-free values.
proved.conditions: None beyond the stated structures
proved.assessment: Known theorems reproved in the pure core; substantive as formalizations. The prose matches.

proved.claim: How G0 is characterized: on a connected whole with a living claim, G0 is equivalent to a seed plus N_rel plus N_std. Where every living claim is held, G0 is equivalent to S0 everywhere plus N_std. Along dependence the center is not derived. The dynamics do not decide G0. The axiom is G0 for anything, and under it G0 holds with relevance read from significance.
proved.where: Metaethics.lean:192; Standpoints.lean:104, :136, :435; Significance.lean:134, :447; Relevance.lean:96, :103, :125, :144; chapter lines 89, 122, 676–694

The prose at line 686 is honest, but the opening's 'G0 is a theorem' overstates what is proved.

proved.conditions: Transmission is a premise; share_rises assumes a binary trait with separated offspring counts

issues.title: 'Law (no premise)' covers results with hypotheses about finiteness, decidability, local balance and listing
issues.description: Line 62/95 defines a 'law' as holding 'with no premise'. Line 67/100 says 'The following hold of every world, with no premise about the unfolding'. Item 2 then lists results that assume a finite world with decided activity, balance at a condition (one of the eight premises of item 3), a family that is balanced and dissipated on, or a listing. In practice the law/theorem split is about whether the hypothesis is local, not whether a hypothesis exists, so the headline that Part I 'states what holds of every unfolding' reads stronger than the Lean.
issues.evidence: Space.lean:273 `arising_iff_ceasing [∀ t x, Decidable ...] (finite : w.Finite)`; Locality.lean:178 `BalancesOn.comesToStand_iff (balances : L.BalancesOn W cs t)`; chapter lines 70, 72, 103, 105 call these laws
issues.fix: Rename the category to 'laws with local hypotheses'. Write each hypothesis into the item (finite, decided, balanced at c, listed). Reserve 'no premise' for change_readings, over_stretch, price and the like. Have the status table distinguish 'no hypothesis', 'local hypothesis' and 'premise selection'.
issues.verify_reason: The cited hypotheses exist: Space.lean:273 arising_iff_ceasing takes [Decidable] and w.Finite, and Locality.lean:178 BalancesOn.comesToStand_iff takes `balances`. But the chapter discloses the convention it uses. Line 62/95 says decidedness is 'the own condition of the laws that count or name a step, written within the law'. Line 67/100 lists 'laws of one step with their condition inside them' as one of the four kinds. Line 110 says 'Where a premise holds at every step these conditions hold everywhere, so the selection results … are their corollaries'. A conditional statement whose hypothesis is local still holds of every world, so 'holds of every world' is logically correct. What remains is a terminology problem: the phrase 'no premise about the unfolding' sits awkwardly beside per-step hypotheses such as BalancesOn, which are facts about the unfolding. That is local wording, not an overclaim about what is proved.
issues.corrected_fix: Keep the 'law' category. In items 2 and 4, rephrase 'with no premise about the unfolding' as 'with no global premise; local conditions are written into each law', and tag each bullet with its local condition (finite + decided, balanced at c, listed). A three-way status column is optional.

issues.title: Decidedness called both a representation commitment and not one

issues.title: Opening presents 'G0 is a theorem' although it follows by unfolding definitions
issues.description: 'In one sentence' and 'Two targets' say that, with the axiom as a condition, G0 is a theorem and that G0 'supplies reasons addressed to every situated intelligence'. Line 686 states this honestly ('G0 is the axiom's condition on realized living content'), but the headline invites readers to think something substantive was derived. Web.significance_undetermined only compares the all-true and the all-false valuation.

One detail of the description is wrong: Web.significance_undetermined comparing only the all-true and all-false valuations is not a weakness, because two dynamics-consistent valuations suffice to show the dynamics do not decide significance.

proved.claim: OPENING's laws that hold in every world as represented: arising and ceasing are one change; in a finite family comings to be and ceasings to be keep pace; asked of every finite world without decision, the recurrence law is equivalent to excluded middle.
proved.conditions: Discrete steps, ℕ amounts, what is counted decided at each step (for keep_pace).
proved.assessment: change_readings is ⟨.rfl ×6⟩, a definition read six ways. keep_pace is a counting bound. law_iff_em is a genuine constructive calibration. OPENING's footnote calls all three 'Proved', which overstates the kind of result for change_readings.

proved.claim: Conditional laws in OPENING: what is closed cannot go on forever without coming to rest; what keeps going is fed from beyond; joint draws within renewal can end it; a part can thrive while closing others' world; once nothing is supported, nothing is supported again.
proved.where: Openness.lean, Continuation.lean, Regions.lean, Admission.lean; OPENING.md:9 and [^conditions]
proved.conditions: Balance, dissipation, census, embodiment and enclosure as theorem hypotheses. The rest and fed-from-beyond conclusions are doubly negated.
proved.assessment: Substantive but modest accounting results in the discrete ℕ representation. OPENING v6 now matches the ¬¬ form. That balance and dissipation correspond to conservation and the second law is a modelling claim and remains open.

proved.claim: With the one axiom as a condition (Unrestricted: from every standpoint, the continuation of anything has significance), G0, S0 and both neutralities follow. Without it, significance is undetermined, and a significance bounded by a self or region is a consistent rival.
proved.conditions: Unrestricted sig := ∀ p t f, sig p t f. The theory states it as a condition and does not assert it (P128).
proved.assessment: Formally immediate: the axiom is strictly stronger than G0 and makes significance constant. The value lies in the premise audit, bounded_rival and the presupposition plus invariance decomposition. Not independently reviewed, as OPENING [^axiom] says.

proved.claim: Margin laws: a part loses significance exactly where its net draw exceeds the margin, and adds exactly where its net giving lets something form; a free rider loses from every standpoint; mixed parts are unordered without a further measure.
proved.conditions: Balanced flow and a given significance sig. The iff laws hold for every sig.
proved.assessment: The arithmetic is real, but it is not owed to the axiom. Under Unrestricted every closing loses (apoptosis and ending a cancer included), so 'explains good and evil' (OPENING:19) needs a measure that is still open (Transfer.unordered).

proved.claim: §7 AI-alignment direction: align AI formation, learning, action and revision with actual living and further generation, governed by real losses, basic conditions, bounded responsibility and legitimate participation; correction must be an executable sequence.
proved.where: Chapter lines 1329–1351; record alignment-direction-g0-j (reviewed-scoped, argument; AlignmentDirection.lean, Bridge.lean); conditions in reserved-shutdown-during-recovery, recoverable-mediated-change, assured-route-criterion, risk-certificate-outcome-distinction (periphery, recorded-checked)
proved.conditions: The condition of §6.15, J1–J4, A and L, and warranted correspondence to actual AI systems.
proved.assessment: Honestly scoped as a proposal. It proves neither compliance nor reliability in deployment. The four checked correction conditions are listed and linked in Chinese only (1343–1348); the English paragraph (1351) omits them.

proved.claim: Recurrence: within finitely many configurations a law loses nothing exactly when every configuration returns; a rise needs a merge; with its history kept, a law loses nothing and never returns.
proved.conditions: No premise; no decidable equality; no choice.
proved.assessment: A classical finite-permutation and pigeonhole result, in a clean constructive formalization.

proved.claim: Identification and distinguishing: bounded records of length N−1, N+N′−1 or 2N−1 fix the course; the least-bound learner is right from step 2N−1 on, and no learner is right at 2N−2; the refutation learner rests at a cubic step.
proved.conditions: A bound on the number of states (the least-bound learner needs none).
proved.assessment: Moore 1956 and Fine–Wilf are credited in §9 row 1609. Gold-style identification in the limit is credited only in Lean docstrings. The cubic constant is plausibly new but narrow. The exact odd-N constant is open; the search up to N ≤ 17 is a computation, not a proof.

proved.claim: Constructive calibrations: a counterexample to the least registration exists exactly where a rule decides falsity-throughout (WLPO as a rule); deciding vanishing is LPO as a rule; runs from every keeps-moving family are exactly dependent choice; EitherThroughout is LLPO for decided families.
proved.conditions: Conditions numbered by ℕ where stated.
proved.assessment: Correct, and the distinctive contribution: a map of exactly where EM, WLPO, LPO and DC enter. The chapter credits neither Bishop, Ishihara nor Bridges–Richman, and §8's logical-commitment item (1468) omits LLPO.

proved.claim: Parity gluing and Mermin–Peres: context-free values exist exactly where no set of contexts contradicts; the quantum square admits no context-free assignment.
proved.conditions: Parity constraints; integer matrices.
proved.assessment: Classical (Mermin/Peres credited). Abramsky et al. and Arkhipov are credited only in the Lean docstrings.

proved.claim: One root (P130): every reading of the unfolding is a run; a world is exactly a run of the law it shows; a world balances exactly where its run is a run of the law of exchange.
proved.conditions: No premise beyond what each theorem names. The theorems are correspondences, not redefinitions.
proved.assessment: Several are near-definitional (run_world). THEOREM-CONNECTIVITY §7 shows the families still do not reach each other by definition (1,019 of 7,214 theorems apart). Unreviewed, and absent from the canonical chapter.

proved.claim: Loops and frequency: the carried difference is at most D·(1+M)^a over the steps at which couplings act; growth is polynomial exactly where no loop lies upstream; a self-loop's polynomial bound is characterized.
proved.conditions: Given ℕ coupling strengths and schedules.
proved.assessment: Truncated Neumann and path-sum expansions in ℕ. No classical credit in §9 rows 1641–1648. The spectral-radius rate is open because it needs real amounts.

proved.claim: Truth exists: a law of how anything comes to be holds 'in every universe', and the whole theory is deductively necessary without added substantive axioms.
proved.conditions: None proved.
proved.assessment: An open target. OPENING [^law] and the chapter disclose this. Nothing in Lean establishes the necessity of the whole, or that every becoming can be represented with discrete steps and ℕ amounts.

areas.summary:
The A–C slice of theories/becoming/chapters/ holds 26 Markdown files (882 KB) and the executable leftover chapters/verification/ (13 files, 76 KB, dated 10-05). Two groups make it up.

(1) Nineteen studies from the pre-spine "generative grounding" programme, dated 5–8 October 2026: ABSTRACTION-ACQUISITION, ALIGNMENT-AND-GOVERNANCE, ALIGNMENT-AXIS, ALIGNMENT-COMPLETION, the two ARCHITECTURE-* files, ASSUMPTION-FREE-FOUNDATION, ATTAINABLE-MATHEMATICAL-QUESTIONS, AUTONOMOUS-METHOD-FORMATION, CLAIMS-AND-PAID-ACTION, COGNITION-LI-AND-RECIPROCITY, COMPLETION-PLAN, the two CONCERN-* files, CONDITIONAL-UNIVERSALITY, CONNECTED-GENERATIVE-MODEL, CONTROLLED-REFINEMENT, COST-SENSITIVE-LEARNING and CYBERNETICS. Seventeen of them have not changed in content since the 10-09 directory rename (commit 87fdbb077). The other two got only wording edits: ABSTRACTION-ACQUISITION on 10-11 and CONNECTED-GENERATIVE-MODEL on 10-10. No result record cites any of the 19, and neither does the canonical chapter. They are reached through the reading catalogue (results/ARGUMENTS-A-L.md), the historical hub GENERATIVE-GROUNDING.md and the generativity-chain data. Most are finite conditional constructions with honest scope statements and their own Lean or Python receipts. Several are accreted session logs rather than arguments:
- ALIGNMENT-AND-GOVERNANCE: 106 KB, 57 dated status paragraphs, a 12 KB preamble before its first heading.
- ASSUMPTION-FREE-FOUNDATION: 41 headings, about 25 one-paragraph "assessment" stubs.
- CONNECTED-GENERATIVE-MODEL: 27 "Acquired …" continuation sections.

(2) Seven files that are still current or cited:
- BECOMING-FOUNDATION: an active study. The canonical chapter's §5 points here for the open deduction.
- ALIGNMENT-DIRECTION: an active study and the source for canonical §7.
- ALIGNMENT-THROUGH-CHANGE: cited by canonical §7 and by 3 records.
- BASIC-CONFLICT-JUDGMENT and CHOICE-AND-GENERATIVE-CONTEXT: statement sources of records. They were updated on 10-13 and 10-14 (P89 bridge, FR).
- COGNITION-LEARNING-AND-EVOLUTION: tied to the active cognition goal in GOALS.md. Its §2 states the spine learning laws P73 and P74.
- CLAIMS.md: a generated register. Its 229 rows are identical to RESULTS.md and results/RESULT-REGISTER.md.

Ten record references bind these chapters by sha256, and all catalogue hashes are fresh. Every local link in the 26 files resolves. Only CLAIMS.md has a preserved snapshot under _process/architecture/history (2e9e081ccd2d6d27). The rest live only in git history and as catalogue summaries.

No chapter contradicts a Lean theorem. The conflicts are in status language and in staleness:
- ALIGNMENT-DIRECTION still presents G0 as the "Foundational axiom". G0 was folded on 10-11, and on 10-16 the one axiom became a condition the theory does not assert.
- The BECOMING-FOUNDATION §5 audit is frozen at P23–P30 (10-10) and still treats the generative/degenerative overlap as Ren's open choice. The canonical chapter records that choice as decided (D2).
- The ALIGNMENT-THROUGH-CHANGE abstract covers §§1–5 only. Its records now state general laws (Becoming.Countdown) that the chapter never mentions.
- The canonical premise card omits the practical commitments BC1, BC2, LC, LR, CP, NP and FR, which these chapters introduced.

Several hand-proved or older-model results now have Lean counterparts on the spine:
- ABSTRACTION-ACQUISITION's test-depth bound: Becoming.Distinguishing.
- ALIGNMENT-AND-GOVERNANCE's viability recurrence: Becoming.Viability.
- ASSUMPTION-FREE's history-derived law: Becoming.Unfolding.

None of these is cross-referenced. CONDITIONAL-UNIVERSALITY's U1–U3 have no record and no spine instance.

Recommended restructure:
- Move the 19 historical files to theories/becoming/history/. It sits at the same depth as chapters/, so all ../../../ links stay valid. Reuse the 10-09 rename-receipt method; 959 files link the 19, about 730 of them inside the generative-foundation-review study.
- Keep the 7 current files.
- Rewrite BECOMING-FOUNDATION §5, the ALIGNMENT-DIRECTION G0 status note and the ALIGNMENT-THROUGH-CHANGE summary.
- Reduce CLAIMS.md to a generated redirect page.
- Register the open alignment-application target before moving ALIGNMENT-COMPLETION.

proved.claim: Pooling processes keeps exactly the union of their finite endpoint histories iff that union is closed under joining at the shared boundary; retaining context realizes the union exactly.

proved.assessment: Correct but elementary: the automata union/closure fact, which the chapter honestly credits to Sipser. It is a coherence constraint, not a step of the open whole deduction, and the prose says so.

proved.claim: A reduction's readout is single-valued exactly where the observable agrees across what the reduction merges, so no map restores two merged configurations. In a real-amplitude control fragment, controlled X/Z order and complete dephasing keep the branch weights while the plus response moves 1 → 0 → 1/2; retaining the joint register allows reversal.
proved.conditions: Quantum operations and interpretation are supplied; 27 theorems, of which 10 have standard dependencies.
proved.assessment: A substantive-looking, honest restricted calculation. The chapter explicitly declines claims about causal nonseparability or quantum theory from zero axioms.

proved.claim: For every partial law and admission, a property holds after every admitted course exactly when every admitted step keeps it. Counted work finishes in work+1 ticks exactly when fuel covers them. A reserved exit with a decreasing margin ends every long course at the exit. The recovery, mediated-control and reserved-shutdown devices are instances.
proved.conditions: The general laws are core and premise-free. The device instances are periphery (universal-ethics/generative-capacity) with a supplied grammar, runtime mediation and fault coverage.
proved.assessment: The general laws are standard invariant/induction facts; the substance is the finite device modelling. The chapter's prose (10-08) describes only the device-level results and is silent on the general-law form the records now claim.

proved.claim: The alignment direction (G0 → disclosed comparison J1–J4 → bounded practical requirements → AI application) discriminates expansion, service, transfer and abrupt withdrawal in a worked case.
proved.conditions: G0 (now a theorem under the unasserted §6.15 condition) plus the AI-authored J1–J4; the Lean case stipulates plans 0–3 and Bool claims (89-line file).
proved.assessment: An argument, not a proof. The Lean is a consistency check of a stipulated toy case, definitional by construction, and the chapter says it certifies no real classification. Its status wording for G0 is out of date.

proved.claim: FR (finite responsiveness): among same-kind recoverable basic losses, a finite scale of joint lesser protection can gain sufficient grounds over a fixed graver loss; loss-matching laws give its formal content.
proved.conditions: FR is an additional, revisable normative commitment; the sufficiency of complete-episode matching is an explicit hypothesis; receipt becoming-checks/20261014T141427.442103Z.
proved.assessment: The normative content is argued; Lean checks only the instance-level matching. The record is honest, but the canonical premise card omits FR.

proved.claim: Along one history, unfinished current-rule steps that lower a certificate, plus a non-increasing handoff, guarantee completion within the finite-renewal bound. Per-rule finishing and local progress alone do not guarantee realization under repeated revision.
proved.conditions: An explicit correspondence to actual new generation is supplied; the P89 Bridge adapters connect it to the shared Frame/Run.
proved.assessment: A standard ranking-function termination argument plus a genuine counterexample to a tempting stronger claim. The prose matches.

proved.claim: In a declared connectionist construction, exposure followed by faithful reconstruction passes on the network and procedure bit and conserves material and support, so whole performance can change reconstruction of the procedure governing internal change.
proved.conditions: Supplied hardware, tanh response, update laws, affine channels and exact matrix copying.
proved.assessment: A finite specified construction; conditional and honestly scoped.

proved.claim: Learning laws on the spine (P73/P74): no record fixes the next value; every learner has a diagonal course refuting each of its claims; learning by refutation never passes a holding hypothesis; transfer is generalization exactly through a lumping.

proved.claim: Conditional universality U1–U3: under a per-transition law held+enacted ≤ held+arrived, every prefix obeys E_n + h(s_n) ≤ h(s_0) + Λ_n; unbounded enactment requires unbounded arrival; bounded acyclic support ranks impose the deadline e ≤ (rank+1)L.

areas.summary:
This area has 25 earlier chapters, about 601 KB in total. All were written by the AI between 5 and 9 October 2026, under the "generative grounding" programme or the G0/J explicit-axiom route. One section was added on 13 October (PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT §2.1). The catalogue hashes are fresh for all 25 (the source_sha256 in theories/becoming/results/data/arguments-m-z.json matches every file), and all 450 relative links in them resolve. The canonical chapter replaces their role as entry points (THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md §11, lines 1885–1897), but it names only three of them: PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT, PLURAL-SYSTEMS-AND-CORRECTION (in the 'historical evidence' row, line 1896) and PHILOSOPHICAL-ACCOUNT (cited at line 606). Only PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT is the canonical_source of a result record (practical-judgment-g0-j, reviewed-scoped), and its Lean module PracticalJudgment is the only one in the area that the spine imports (Becoming/Bridge.lean). For the other 24 there is no record, so their status lives only in the 8 October reading catalogue and in the I4a draft MODULE-CLASSIFICATION.md.

The chapters fall into three groups.

(a) **Current arguments still used.** Six chapters: PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT, PHILOSOPHICAL-ACCOUNT (KNOWLEDGE.md:7 calls it the 'current synthesis'), PLURAL-SYSTEMS-AND-CORRECTION (§15 holds Ren's 9 October 'responsive transformation' framing), NONINSTRUMENTAL-CONCERN (一体之仁 and the C2 problem), RELATIONS-ACROSS-SCALES and PRE-QIN-AND-WENYAN (an open direction Ren confirmed). Ren's generativity chain cites four of these 2–7 times each.

(b) **A finite-construction cluster from 5–6 October.** Seventeen short chapters, about 229 KB: PROTOCOL-*, PREDICTION-*, RECIPIENT-*, RECORDED-REASONS, REASON-PROTECTION, PAID-PREIMPORT-EVIDENCE, ROUTE-DIAGNOSTICS, REVISABLE-CONCERN-SETTLEMENT and three empirical reanalyses. They are toy resource-accounting machines in experiments/shared-renewal-capability. MODULE-CLASSIFICATION classes almost all of their Lean modules as 'application'. RenewalLiquidity is an 'earlier version' of Becoming.Stock.covered_iff_prefix. ProtocolComposition and ProtocolCompletion are 'join candidates'.

(c) **Two superseded index-like chapters.** NEW-POSSIBILITIES (its general laws are now in Becoming.Novelty, Gain, Description and Readout) and PROVED-CONNECTIONS (superseded by DEPENDENCIES.md, THEOREM-CONNECTIVITY.md and MODULE-CLASSIFICATION.md).

None of the 25 chapters carries a status banner pointing to the canonical chapter or the spine. That remains true even where the Lean files have received I4c header notes, such as RenewalLiquidity, EvidenceThroughChange and SeededContinuation.

**Accreted chapters.**
- PHILOSOPHICAL-ACCOUNT declares 'The endpoint reached' at §10, then runs 23 more rounds that close 'the two questions' four separate times.
- NONINSTRUMENTAL-CONCERN (90 KB) stacks two numbered sequences, so there are two §9s on the same question.
- RELATIONS-ACROSS-SCALES (77 KB, 21 sections, 7 Lean modules) drifts from the adequacy of scales to continuation planning, which is now on the spine.

**Conflicts with the canonical chapter.** These concern G0's status:
- PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT:19 still calls G0 'Authorized foundational axiom'.
- PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT:67 says that Part II's axiom 'yields' G0. Since P128 there is no Part II, and the theory does not assert the axiom (§6.15).
- PHILOSOPHICAL-ACCOUNT says 'under the accepted axioms'.

No Lean claim in the area was found wrong. Every spot-checked theorem count matches its receipt. Most proofs are elementary (order theory, pigeonhole counting, discrete Grönwall-type error bounds), and the chapters mostly describe them honestly.

**Recommendation.**
- Keep the six chapters in group (a), with status banners. Rewrite PHILOSOPHICAL-ACCOUNT and PLURAL-SYSTEMS, and split RELATIONS-ACROSS-SCALES.
- Move the 17-chapter cluster, NEW-POSSIBILITIES and PROVED-CONNECTIONS to a dated history folder with an index. Follow the 9 October rename precedent: a manifest plus a check script, with live links rewritten and frozen evidence keeping its old paths. This touches about 427 live link occurrences in about 193 files and leaves about 3,092 frozen references in 214 files on their old paths. It also needs the generativity-chain maintenance workflow for 8 chain references.

areas.summary:
This area is 28 chapters in theories/becoming/chapters/ whose names start with H to M. Together they hold 833,778 bytes. All were written between 5 and 8 October 2026, before the Becoming spine existed. None has had a substantive edit since 10 October; the last change was P36b on 10 October (ba3b0e3b6, title lines only), and before that the rename commit 87fdbb077 on 9 October. They come from the "generative foundation" programme of 5–8 October. They fall into six series:
(a) the 慧根/wisdom-root log, HUIGEN.md at 247 KB;
(b) the mathematics line: MATHEMATICS-AND-GENERATIVITY, MATHEMATICAL-ROOT-FRONTIER, MATHEMATICAL-TRUTH-AND-THE-ROOT, IMMANENT- and INQUIRY-AND-MATHEMATICAL-IDENTITY (155 KB);
(c) the joint-formation strategic game (4 files, 75 KB);
(d) a finite constructed-learner chain from 6 October: INQUIRY-REVISION, LEARNING-INTERFACE/-ROUTE-REVISION, three MATERIAL-*, MODEL-FAMILY/META/METHOD-REVISION (9 files, 109 KB);
(e) scoped empirical correspondence: MEASURED-FEEDBACK, MEMORY-CORRECTION, LIVING-DEPENDENCIES (51 KB);
(f) six still-cited or goal-anchored pages: KNOWLEDGE, MARKETS-AND-GENERATIVE-REGIMES with its MARKET-DYNAMICS-MATH appendix, LIANGZHI-EVOLUTION, HANZI-AND-THEORY-TREE, MATHEMATICAL-CORE.

**How they connect to the rest of the repo.**
- The canonical chapter's §11 names only three of the 28: KNOWLEDGE as an active study, JOINT-FORMATION and MARKETS as evidence. The other 25 fall under "其余见目录" (the rest are in the catalogue).
- None of the 28 links to THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md or to any Becoming spine module.
- Only KNOWLEDGE (1 record) and MARKETS (4 records) are bound by sha256 from result records.
- All 28 have entries in the reading catalogue (ARGUMENTS-A-L/M-Z, data dated 8 October), and their hashes match.
- Eight are hash-bound in the generativity chain's reviewed_sources.
- None has a snapshot under _process/architecture/history.
- They receive more than 3,000 inbound references, mostly from the root-foundation study's evidence JSON. HUIGEN alone has 399 referencing files; LIANGZHI has 340.

**Condition.**
- Every local link resolves, and the arithmetic I spot-checked is right: the LIANGZHI counterexample gives 13/30, and the MARKETS K_N closed form matches the record's recurrence.
- Most results are unmigrated (no record) and stay at their original Lean, hand-proof or empirical scope.
- Several pages still call themselves "current" (HUIGEN, LIANGZHI, LIVING, KNOWLEDGE), although the canonical chapter has replaced them as entry points.
- HUIGEN and the tail of KNOWLEDGE are session logs that grew by accretion. HUIGEN's §8 calls itself a "cumulative record".
- KNOWLEDGE, the one chapter §11 calls active, still asserts G0 without condition. The canonical chapter, after P128, no longer asserts it.
- MARKETS lags its own records: on 14 October they were restated on the spine (Becoming.Viability, Becoming.Lasting, MarketInstances) and upgraded to exactness.
- The joint-formation series frames shared activity as a game among opposed, separately owned agents with an equilibrium. AGENTS.md and canonical §4 now reject that framing, yet §11 lists the series as evidence without a caveat.
- The mathematics line is missing from both the canonical chapter and GOALS. On 16 October Ren chose to keep it as "a separate mathematical line that the theory uses", outside the spine for now. Its three status pages duplicate each other's prepended summaries.

**Restructuring.** Moving files is risky:
- Hard-coded consumers exist: lean_catalogue.py anchors, HUIGEN-CHECK.py's CAN path, and check_release.py's hash pin on JOINT-FORMATION-MATH, which silently skips if the file is missing.
- Bindings exist in records and in the generativity chain.
- Thousands of evidence references point at the current paths.

So the recommended order is:
1. Add status notes and a generated series index, and fix §11.
2. Do the rewrites: KNOWLEDGE, MARKETS, a short HUIGEN stub, and one merged mathematics-line chapter.
3. Move series to history only through the 9 October rename mechanism. Each moved file leaves a stub at its old path that keeps its original heading anchors.

areas.summary:
This area holds 27 Markdown chapters (1.23 MB, about 20% of the 6.19 MB chapters/ directory) and the 13-file verification/ bundle (76 KB). Almost all of them predate the canonical chapter. 22 of the 27 were last touched by the 9 October rename commit 87fdbb077. Three more got one-line wording edits on 9–10 October (85b6d341b, ba3b0e3b6). Only three still change: SCIENTIFIC-PHILOSOPHY.md, WISDOM-AND-CONTEXT.md and ZERO-AXIOM-PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT.md, which received the Codex 13 October sections in 8f7734b41 (+104/+186/+127 lines). Those three are the `canonical_source` of three open targets: scientific-inquiry-foundation, wisdom-root and universal-practical-warrant. THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md is the source of five recorded-checked records but has been frozen since 10 October.

There are five groups:
- (a) The 5 October unified-synthesis package (START-HERE, THEORY, SOURCE-MAP, SYNTHESIS-RECORD, plus verification/). This is historical, and its release receipt is stale: 11 of its 15 hashes no longer match.
- (b) Early local-mechanism studies from 6–8 October: SELECTOR-REVISION, UPDATER-FORMATION, SUCCESSOR-LEARNING, STOCHASTIC-PREDICTION-COMPOSITION, SEMANTIC-ACTION-COMPOSITION, SEMANTIC-CALIBRATION and VALUATION-IDENTIFICATION-BOUNDS. MODULE-CLASSIFICATION classes their Lean as "application". No record or canonical section cites them.
- (c) Ethics chapters from the G0-as-axiom period: UNIFIED-ETHICAL-GROUNDING, UNIVERSAL-ETHICAL-MINIMUM, STRONGEST-FOUNDATION-CLAIM, SHENGSHENG and SUSTAINED-LIVING-JUDGMENT. Canonical §6 has superseded them: G0 was folded on 11 October, and Part II became the conditional §6.15 on 16 October.
- (d) Unique evidence the canonical chapter does not cover: TOOL-EVIDENCE-AND-AUTHORITY (AgentDojo audit), WANG-YANGMING, SYSTEMS-COMPLEXITY-CHAOS, SYSTEM-INDIVIDUATION, SYSTEM-WARRANT and VALUATION-DEVELOPMENT.
- (e) Programme and active studies: THEORY-OF-BECOMING, THE-THEORY-OF-EVOLUTION, plus the three Codex-line chapters above.

The main problem is navigation, not mathematics. I found no claimed theorem that is wrong. Spot checks found the cited declarations: `Becoming.alike_iff_sameTests`, the `Becoming.FallibleInquiry` bounds, the `RegroupingSelection` adapters, the `RelationalRenewal` overdraw theorems and the RealFeedback intervals.

The navigation problems:
- None of the 27 chapters links THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md anywhere.
- §11 of the canonical chapter calls two frozen chapters "active" and omits the three live ones.
- Several chapters still state in the present tense that G0 is the authorized or starting axiom. These are UNIFIED-ETHICAL-GROUNDING.md:3 (titled "Current alignment task"), SHENGSHENG.md:174, THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md:91 and THE-THEORY-OF-EVOLUTION.md:112.
- WISDOM-AND-CONTEXT.md:200 still refers to Part II.

UNIFIED-ETHICAL-GROUNDING.md (412 KB, 1,705 lines, 55 H2 and 85 H3 sections, 40 distinct Ren source records cited) is a session log of dated continuations, not an argument. It cannot simply be moved: 477 files and 2,544 anchored links (109 anchors) point into it. The zero-axiom normative-warrant question is split across four chapters (UNIFIED-ETHICAL-GROUNDING, ZERO-AXIOM-PRACTICAL-JUDGMENT, STRONGEST-FOUNDATION-CLAIM, UNIVERSAL-ETHICAL-MINIMUM), plus canonical §6.11/§8 and one open record.

None of these chapters has a snapshot under _process/architecture/history. Preserved copies exist elsewhere: the 5 October package originals in sources/22-research-reconciliation-2026-10-05/…/fo/outputs/unified-theory/, and before-snapshots in root-foundation/development/ (22 for UNIFIED-ETHICAL-GROUNDING, 11 for UNIVERSAL-ETHICAL-MINIMUM, 1 for WANG-YANGMING).

The repository already has a model for the cleanup: Ren's I4a/I4c procedure for Lean modules (draft a classification table first, then add header notes, then move) together with the 9 October rename receipt.
