areas.summary:
This area holds 31 chapters written between 5 and 10 October 2026, before the canonical THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md and the pure Lean spine `Becoming` existed. They fall into six groups:
(1) the old foundation programme: GENERATIVE-GROUNDING, FOUNDATION-PREMISES, GENERATIVE-DEVELOPMENT, DEEPER-GENERATIVE-ROOT, EMPIRICAL-SCOPE and GENERATIVE-SELECTION;
(2) older formal compendia: FORMAL-CORE, FORMAL-SPECIFICATION and GENERATIVE-CORE-LEAN;
(3) a finite learning-and-evaluation chain: five EVALUATIVE-* chapters, FORMED-ROUTE-MONITOR and EXPERIMENTAL-ACCESS. These are steps of one deeply nested experiment under experiments/shared-renewal-capability/...;
(4) ethics and alignment: ETHICAL-FOUNDATION, ETHICAL-LEARNING, GENERATED-SELF-AND-ETHICS, G0-WARRANT, EVALUATION-AND-FAITHFUL-REPORTING and EVIDENCE-AND-INSTITUTIONAL-CORRECTION;
(5) a 10-05 game-theory trio: FORMATION, FORMATION-MATH and FORMATION-PRIOR-ART;
(6) standalone branches: EXPLANATORY-NECESSITY, GENERATED-LOGIC, GENERATIVE-MATHEMATICAL-ADMISSIBILITY, GOAL-FORMATION-AND-REVISION, EVOLUTIONARY-ORGANIZATION and DAO-AND-GENERATIVITY.

Condition:
- **Not edited since the G0 fold.** None of the 31 was edited after 2026-10-11. 27 were last touched only by the 10-09 directory rename (commit 87fdbb07). So none reflects the G0 fold (10-11), Part II folded into §6.15 (10-16) or the zero-premise Part I.
- **Almost no links forward.** 30 of 31 contain no link to the canonical chapter or the spine; the exception, G0-WARRANT, links Becoming.Metaethics twice. None carries a banner stating its standing. The only place that classifies them is canonical §11, lines 1893–1898.
- **Catalogue entries are fresh but frozen.** The reading-catalogue hashes all match, because nothing changed. The catalogue's question routes are hard-coded in tools/research/reading_catalogue.py, and they still send readers to GENERATIVE-GROUNDING, FOUNDATION-PREMISES and GENERATIVE-CORE-LEAN as the answer to "what foundation is established" and "how far do the mathematical results reach".
- **Records rarely cite the chapters.** Only two records use one of these chapters as canonical_source: ETHICAL-LEARNING (organizational-formation-from-generative-comparison) and GENERATED-LOGIC (constitutive-binding-assessment). About 25 records cite the integration studies behind the chapters instead.
- **Several chapters are accreted session logs, not arguments:**
  - GENERATIVE-GROUNDING: 409 KB, of which about 302 KB is 302 dated status paragraphs.
  - ETHICAL-LEARNING: 215 KB, 88 numbered rounds, with withdrawn §§67–74 left inline.
  - EXPLANATORY-NECESSITY: 134 KB, 109 rounds.
- **Stale or misleading claims:**
  - G0-WARRANT, which canonical §11 lists as an active study, still says G0 "is an adopted axiom".
  - The goal records still bind the generative-foundation completion criterion to GENERATIVE-GROUNDING, which the canonical chapter calls historical.
  - Canonical §5 cites EVALUATIVE-UPTAKE and EVALUATIVE-GROUNDING as established routes. But the "warranted" reading in those chapters rests on a repair/entitlement premise that builds on ETHICAL-FOUNDATION's subject-standing premises, and that premise is not on the premise card.

Formally:
- **Spine connection.** The area's strongest checked content is the G0 characterization, now in the core (Becoming.Metaethics), and the explanatory joining results, bridged into Becoming.Joining and Becoming.Composition.
- **Periphery.** The rest is checked periphery Lean, much of it elementary, under supplied local laws; historical hand proofs (FORMAL-CORE F1–F13, FORMATION-MATH); and philosophical arguments.
- **Mostly honest about scope.** Most chapters state their scope carefully. The overclaim risks are wording: "complete explanation", and "independently accepted" used without saying the review was an internal AI review.

Restructure recommendation:
- Keep in place, with banners: GENERATED-LOGIC, ETHICAL-LEARNING (rewritten compactly), EXPLANATORY-NECESSITY (rewritten compactly), EVOLUTIONARY-ORGANIZATION, GOAL-FORMATION-AND-REVISION, GENERATIVE-MATHEMATICAL-ADMISSIBILITY and DAO-AND-GENERATIVITY.
- Rewrite G0-WARRANT to reflect the fold.
- Extract GENERATIVE-GROUNDING's status log to history, keeping its anchors. It has about 1025 live inbound links and two goal records depend on it.
- Move the remaining 21 chapters into theories/becoming/history/ in five groups, using the 10-09 rename tooling for link rewrites and a provenance manifest.

proved.claim: G0 content characterization: on a connected whole with some living claim, G0 held from every standpoint is equivalent to a seed plus the two boundary neutralities N_rel and N_std. Each conjunct has a countermodel.
proved.conditions: Connectedness and a living claim are hypotheses. S0, N_rel, N_std and A are explicit premises, not proved.
proved.assessment: A substantive characterization with minimality. The G0 ⇒ premises direction is nearly trivial, as the record itself says. G0-WARRANT's description matches the Lean, but it still calls G0 an adopted axiom.

proved.claim: Under a no-recovery wear law, formation within the renewal rate continues forever; formation beyond it is bounded, ceases and permanently loses capacity, taking dependent formation with it. A one-step count ranks the consuming option first.
proved.conditions: A supplied WearLaw: renewal never rises and drops strictly under excess pressure.
proved.assessment: Correct, but elementary Nat arithmetic. The record admits the supplied law carries most of the distinction. The prose's caution about one-step counts is accurate.

proved.claim: Basic-condition priority (J2) is independent of the comparison C and of G0, and no natural-number score satisfying C represents J2.
proved.conditions: One constructed situation: option 0 keeps the basic condition; option k>0 loses it and gains k.
proved.assessment: Correct and small. It is the standard result that a lexicographic preference is not representable by an unbounded Archimedean score; a bounded rational score does represent it.

proved.claim: Classification-robust comparison: A beats B under every assignment of fresh contents to tiers exactly when A keeps all of B's fresh contents and is better with all of them counted as secondary. So checking the two extreme assignments suffices.
proved.where: universal-ethics/generative-capacity/ClassificationRobustJudgment.lean; ETHICAL-LEARNING §86; restated on the frame in Becoming.CoursesBridge
proved.conditions: Fixed meanings; the existing two-tier J1/J2 comparator; fresh contents already interpreted under G0.
proved.assessment: A genuine though small lemma. The prose matches and keeps its scope.

proved.claim: Organizational formation requirement: in a finite nonempty eligible range, if every continuation lacking relation R is strictly improved on by an eligible construction, every undefeated choice includes R.
proved.conditions: G0, J1–J4, complete relational correspondence, and an actual improvement witness for each case lacking R.
proved.assessment: The formal step is elementary order theory; all the normative content is in the supplied improvement witnesses. The chapter says so, but its title 'formation of organizational capacity can be a practical requirement' reads stronger than the lemma.

proved.claim: Explanatory joining: where a joining is functional, two exact reduced accounts of all joining contexts carry the same induced operation, with a unique correspondence. Finite joining trees lift, and joining questions survive encoding.
proved.where: deeper/ExplanatoryContextualStructure.lean and ExplanatoryJoiningBranches.lean; Becoming/Joining.lean (core L3) with Becoming/JoiningBridge.lean; EXPLANATORY-NECESSITY §§84–100; records functional-joining-common-structure, finite-joining-tree-lifting, joining-questions-survive-encoding
proved.conditions: Functional J for uniqueness. Tree lifting and multivalued common structure take excluded middle as a named hypothesis in the core; the original periphery versions used classical axioms.
proved.assessment: Substantive recovery results of bisimulation type, now with a spine home. The chapter's prose matches but never names the spine modules.

proved.claim: First-order wall: two root-generated joint worlds (Nat and streams) agree on every finitary first-order sentence and admit a formula-preserving map, yet are not isomorphic. Truth preservation plus surjectivity is equivalent to isomorphism.
proved.where: deeper/ExplanatoryCardinalityWall.lean; receipt deeper/explanatory-first-order-wall-verification.json (180 audits: 113 empty, 67 standard-axiom); EXPLANATORY-NECESSITY §§77–82
proved.conditions: A finitary relational language with identity, steps and joint triples.
proved.assessment: Correct but standard model theory (a Cantor-diagonal cardinality gap). §83 rightly withdraws reading it as a failure of the common foundation. Uses classical axioms, so it is not core-pure.

proved.claim: Distinction underdetermines dynamics: the same two-state carrier admits incompatible deterministic laws. Given supplied events, sequential reachability is their unique least reflexive-transitive extension.
proved.conditions: Supplied events and carrier.
proved.assessment: Formally trivial (Bool identity versus toggle; a reflexive-transitive closure is the least one). Its philosophical point anticipates the canonical world-first correction, and the prose does not overclaim.

proved.claim: Binding-preserving substitution: every consumer evaluates equally before and after a replacement exactly when each replacement term supplies the ground at its original position.
proved.conditions: A finite typed term language; stable binding positions; no mutable state or divergence.
proved.assessment: A standard substitution lemma. The companion 'constitutive binding' claim is a reviewed philosophical assessment (record constitutive-binding-assessment), not a proof, and the chapter says presuppositionless metalogic is unproved.

areas.summary:
The area is 19 Lean files in experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/ plus the root Becoming.lean. Together they hold 965 theorems (fresh-run summary spine_theorems; the counts match the source). Seventeen are pure-core modules: Admission, Assurance, Attraction, Boundaries, Branching, Capture, Change, Closing, Composition, Contacts, Context, Continuation, ContinuingRevision, Copying, Correspondence, Countdown, Counterfactual. Each one appears in check_becoming.py CORE and in the root import list. Each imports only Becoming.* modules, and through them GenerativeCore and InquirySufficiency. Bridge.lean and CompositionBridge.lean are in BRIDGE, not in CORE and not in the root. Bridge imports `Becoming` and 25 periphery modules; CompositionBridge imports ExplanatoryFootprints. No core module imports either one.

None of the core modules contains sorry, admit, axiom, opaque, unsafe, implemented_by, native_decide, maxHeartbeats or Classical. Context uses kernel `by decide` for the 2^9 Mermin–Peres case, and that is axiom-free. In the in-tree receipt becoming-verification.json (20261016T124157Z, source main 643c345c), the sha256 of all 19 files matches the current bytes. The receipt shows empty axiom reports: its nonempty sets are only generated injEq constants, and none falls in these modules. A fresh run on d21b311a also passed (703 steps). Its summary is kept, but the full receipt was not.

Mathematical quality varies, and the records are honest about it.
- Substantive and nontrivial: Composition (joint Hennessy–Milner-style characterization under compactness and stability; the exact need for excluded middle without stability), Context (Specker, Mermin–Peres, pooled and erased laws), Closing (loops form by closing; polynomial bound before a loop forms), Counterfactual (a course is unique given a non-anticipating law and exists exactly where feasible; sensitivity is the least registration in ¬¬ form), Copying, Change and Countdown (exact accounting laws).
- Elementary but correct: Assurance, Contacts, Admission, Continuation.
- Near-definitional or logical repackaging: Attraction's drawn_iff_not_returns and Branching's necessarilyDrawn_iff_not_returns (the absorbing region used is the point's own forward orbit), Boundaries (the decomposition is a logical equivalence, honestly stated), Capture's perturbation_reabsorbed (immediate from its hypothesis), and most of Bridge (instance identifications, several by Iff.rfl).

The records (attraction-is-not-returning, target-capture, axiom-decomposition) disclose these limits. Some module docstrings do not.

Main problems are navigation, not proof:
1. The four hand-maintained module catalogues (package README, the chapter §9 table, the root Becoming.lean docstring at 105 KB, and the module docstrings) have drifted apart. 18 of 120 chapter rows carry stale theorem counts, including Admission (38 vs 46) and Change (57 vs 59). The README table omits 22 core modules, 5 of them in this area. The README's bridge ring lists only Becoming.Bridge, while the checker has 8 bridge modules; CompositionBridge is mentioned in neither README nor root.
2. A few docstrings are stale or overclaim:
   - Boundaries and Bridge say "the axiom" without noting that P128 made it the unasserted §6.15 condition.
   - Admission's "one of four things" is not a theorem.
   - The Attraction and Branching headlines lack the "close to definitional" caveat.
   - Continuation attributes an AI restatement to Ren's proposal.
3. ContinuingRevision is a domain-specific constructed model with a non-structural title, kept inside the core.
4. Small duplications: helper lemmas re-proved across modules, and Contacts.Alike and ReferencePlan.Alike as two definitions of one notion.

proved.claim: Admission: at a step, a formation is supported exactly when its need plus the part's cumulative take stays within the without-part level plus the part's cumulative give. The levels without a part are unique and the difference is exact. Where nothing is supported, requirements do not loosen and nothing beyond gives, nothing is supported again, and each premise is needed.
proved.conditions: Balanced flow (Flow.Balances), Acting, Dependent; natural quantities, discrete steps, decided part
proved.assessment: Correct, elementary accounting (Nat arithmetic over totals). supported_iff_admits is Iff.rfl. The prose classification that a part 'does one of four things' has no theorem behind it; only witnesses exist.

proved.claim: Assurance: for a determined process, a plan completes exactly when it runs, its run is safe and its endpoint meets the goal. The converse fails for a branching process. For a functional law, completion is the goal at foldl. The traces of a partial law are the runs that runPartial completes.
proved.conditions: Determined P for the converse
proved.assessment: Correct and elementary; the prose matches.

proved.claim: Attraction: for every determined law, a configuration is drawn into some absorbing region exactly when it does not return. Two merged configurations do not both return, with no finiteness. With all configurations listed: lossless iff nothing is drawn (with decidable equality), and every non-returning configuration is drawn into the returning region. Succ and pred witnesses separate the open world from the finite one.
proved.conditions: None for the main law; a list of all configurations and DecidableEq where named
proved.assessment: drawn_iff_not_returns is near-definitional: Drawn quantifies over any absorbing region, and the proof uses the point's own forward orbit (Ahead). 'Drawn' means non-recurrent, not a classical attractor. The record and chapter line 237 say so; the module docstring does not. The finite-case results are classical eventual periodicity.

proved.claim: Boundaries: wherever the whole is an admissible boundary, Unrestricted (Significance's axiom, now the unasserted §6.15 condition) holds exactly when, at every standpoint, the self's presupposition is sub-true and boundary-invariant. Given the presupposition, invariance is the axiom at that standpoint. Route (b) and the axiom are one presupposition at narrow and wide scope. Clearing witnesses show each premise is needed.
proved.conditions: Covering, sub-truth and invariance are hypotheses
proved.assessment: Logically correct short equivalences (supervaluation bookkeeping). The docstring honestly says the decomposition 'does not lower the axiom's content'. Low mathematical content; the value is in locating the premise.

proved.claim: Branching: every process necessarily draws exactly what does not return. Keeping every possibility does not give returning (Transit). A merge need not lose a possibility (OneWay). Merging nothing gives returning along runs within finitely many configurations. Determinacy is the named case of determinacy up to likeness.
proved.conditions: None for the main laws; a list of configurations of a run for the Lossless laws
proved.assessment: The witnesses separating the notions under branching are real content. necessarilyDrawn_iff_not_returns is definitional in the same way as Attraction (Ahead region), and it holds vacuously for configurations with no run, as the docstring says. Chapter line 241 states it without the 'near-definitional' caveat.

proved.claim: Bridge: periphery interfaces (GenerativeComparison G0/C/D, PracticalJudgment, seed–edge closures, ExplanatoryBranching bisimulation and tests, BecomingCompatibility, ChanceAdequacy and others) are instances of core notions. Under Unrestricted, G0 holds for every inventory with relevance read from significance. classification_robust_iff needs exactly excluded middle.
proved.conditions: Bridge ring: imports periphery modules; its own constants have empty axiom reports
proved.assessment: Mostly definitional identifications (11 Iff.rfl, 47 *_by_core), which is their purpose. inventory_g0_of_unrestricted is immediate: the relevance is defined to contain what G0 asks. classification_robust_iff_iff_em is a genuine exactness result.

proved.claim: Capture: carriers leaving at least (strictly more) offspring than others keep (raise) their share, by cross-multiplication. With a standing census, descent stops where what stands runs down from some step on. Where the next configuration ignores the state, perturbing the state is re-absorbed after one step.
proved.conditions: byRule hypothesis (next independent of state); transmission is supplied
proved.assessment: Trivial to elementary. perturbation_reabsorbed follows at once from its hypothesis, and share_rises is an averaging inequality. The readings ('Hijacking is this', 'the rule can reach the standard of reason itself') are labelled the AI's but sit on very little mathematics. The record's limitations say so.

proved.claim: Change: over any stretch, end plus falls equals start plus rises, for a finite family too. Falling at arbitrarily late steps needs rising at arbitrarily late steps. Coming to be recurs exactly when ceasing recurs, for a finite family. Standing recurs iff ceasing to stand recurs, with no premise.
proved.conditions: Decidable determinations for counting; finite lists
proved.assessment: Correct conservation and pigeonhole-style laws. change_readings is Iff.rfl, and the docstring says so explicitly.

proved.claim: Closing: the loops formed by step T+1 are those formed by T plus loops closed by a coupling acting at T, so a loop forms by closing. With no loop upstream by T, the carried amount up to T is polynomial of degree at most n-1. Strengths read off the course generate a course equal to their carried amount. Onset and Threshold witnesses show formation is not foreseen by the amounts before it.
proved.conditions: Listed conditions; ReadsBefore for read strengths
proved.assessment: Substantive combinatorics on coupling chains. The 'unforeseen' claims are witness families, not a general impossibility theorem; the readings generalize from the witness.

proved.claim: Composition: with compact moves and pairs and stable tests, configurations are jointly alike exactly when they pass the same joint tests. Without stability, matching parts (and joint likeness) from the same joint tests in every compact frame holds exactly under excluded middle. Plans lift through descriptions identifying jointly alike configurations. Exclusive footprints support the leaves of a realized plan.
proved.conditions: Compactness (StepCompact, JointCompact) and TestsStable as hypotheses
proved.assessment: The most substantive module in this area: a constructive Hennessy–Milner-type theorem with an exact reverse-mathematics characterization. The prose matches.

proved.claim: CompositionBridge: ExplanatoryJointness and ExplanatoryFootprints results (same_target_unique, compact_same_iff_bisimilar, code_joint_lifts_from_whole, joint_plan_lifts, realized_requests_supported) are instances of Composition. The periphery's classical proofs are replaced by an explicit stability hypothesis with empty axiom reports.
proved.conditions: Stability added where the periphery used Classical.choice or propext
proved.assessment: Correct correspondence results. The docstring is honest that the stability hypothesis is what the classical proof hides.

proved.claim: Contacts: a selection at an address is through a plan exactly when the plan contacts it. A plan change keeps every old selection iff it retains old contacts. A blind revision rule misses some failure at every plan over an unlisted address type. Two reference responses drive a binary channel iff they differ.
proved.conditions: Decidable equality of addresses
proved.assessment: Elementary; answers_iff and blind_answers_iff are close to definitional. Correct.

proved.claim: Context: registrations glue exactly when contexts agree where they meet. A context-free frame fits exactly where registrations glue everywhere. Local possibilities with no global reading admit no gluing configuration (Specker's boxes, the Mermin–Peres square). A pooled law runs exactly the single-context courses iff they are join-closed. The erased law is exact iff contexts lift.
proved.conditions: None beyond the representation; Square.nine by kernel decide
proved.assessment: Correct. The Kochen–Specker-type finite obstructions are genuine, though classical; sources are credited.

proved.claim: Continuation: fed from beyond is exactly not inward (with equality decided). A finite enclosed family under balance and dissipation cannot be fed from nothing beyond. n steps of joint excess need level at least n. Joint net giving restores in m - level steps. Where renewers depend on what they renew, joint excess below need ends them and their dependents.
proved.conditions: Flow.Balances, dissipation, dependence; decided equality
proved.assessment: Correct accounting laws. The endings in the witnesses are stipulated in their activity, as the docstring discloses. The title 'what a continuing formation must count' is normative-sounding, while the content is conservation accounting.

proved.claim: ContinuingRevision: in the constructed revision model, fuel is a Stock balance. With no return no run exists, renewal and success recur along every run, and the cycle repeats for every number of cycles exactly when the yield is at least 9.
proved.conditions: A specific constructed model (seven operations, use 9 per cycle)
proved.assessment: Correct instances of Stock laws on one constructed model. The general content is in Stock; the module is a worked instance with domain vocabulary.

proved.claim: Copying: a copy completes exactly when the pool supplies the word and the support covers the draws. Batches from one pool are all released iff the pool supplies them jointly, independent of order. A lineage needs n-fold supply. Under local draws, use depends only on the number of unlike adjacent pairs. Inspection never increases defects iff the reference agrees at the site. Doubling n rounds needs d*required n k.
proved.conditions: Decidable equality of the alphabet
proved.assessment: Correct multiset-count bookkeeping of moderate length; the prose matches.

proved.claim: Correspondence: under the interaction discipline, idle conditions relate nothing, so the free connection of Q4 is excluded. A renewable condition with a living drawer and dependent connects the whole in two interactions, and G0 there is a seed with N_rel and N_std. In Mutualism, apart dependence relates nothing.
proved.conditions: The interaction discipline is a disclosed correspondence choice
proved.assessment: Correct. The 'Not settled' section is honest (one_use_connects shows the discipline only moves the burden).

proved.claim: Countdown: a property is kept along every reachable course iff every step keeps it. Counted work finishes in work+1 ticks iff the fuel covers them, and stalls beyond. A reserved exit is reached by every admitted course longer than the margin, and the bound is attained.
proved.conditions: Counts/Reserved structures supplied
proved.assessment: Elementary variant arguments, correct. invariant_iff_reach is near-definitional.

proved.claim: Counterfactual: two balanced flows where the part acts alike and the rest follows one non-anticipating law have the same levels and exchange. The generated course exists (balances) exactly where the law is feasible, and the counterfactual of an act is the course it generates. A law reading through a registration gives P65's response premise. Sensitivity is the least registration (¬¬ form). The act is the input of the standard causal model.
proved.conditions: Nonanticipating law, feasibility, finitely many listed conditions for the sensitivity results
proved.assessment: Correct and moderately substantive: uniqueness and existence of solutions of a deterministic recurrence, plus a constructive least-registration result. The 'counterfactual' reading is the AI's (D25).

areas.summary:
This area is the navigation layer of the Theory of Becoming. Outside records/ it holds 28 tracked files, about 19 MB: data/ 11 MB (lean-index.json alone is 8.2 MB), lean-declarations/ 5.8 MB and about 2.0 MB of top-level Markdown. records/ holds the other 23 MB (12 MB of record JSON and 11 MB of generated pages), which makes up the reported 42 MB.

Almost every file is generated. There are six generators in tools/research:
- registry.py writes RESULT-REGISTER.md.
- navigation.py writes ROADMAP.md.
- reading_catalogue.py writes README.md, THEORY-MAP.md and both ARGUMENTS volumes from data/arguments-a-l.json, data/arguments-m-z.json and data/theory-map.json.
- generative_chain.py writes GENERATIVITY-CHAIN.md from data/generativity-chain.json.
- lean_catalogue.py writes LEAN-INDEX.md, LEAN-DECLARATIONS.md, the 10 lean-declarations/*.md pages and data/lean-index.json plus data/source-index.json. session_map.py --capture also writes these same outputs.
- session_map.py writes SESSION-RESULTS.md from data/session-results.json and three JSON files in root-foundation.

The hand-edited inputs are the three reading JSONs, the chain JSON, session-results.json and standard-boundaries.json, which records use.

**Counts.** These are current and reconcile. Git tracks 23,286 .lean files:
- 22,006 are saved copies in checker run folders, which the catalogue excludes on purpose (21,671 of them under experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework).
- The other 1,280 are indexed, with no untracked files among them: 712 working sources, 14 audit drivers, 528 development attempts, 23 imported archives and 3 historical drafts.
- The 18,448 figure is a text count of theorem/lemma lines in the 726 working-source and audit-driver files.
- Of those, the Becoming spine is 138 files with 7,245 occurrences. The current receipt (becoming-verification.json, 20261016T124157) reports 137 spine modules and 7,214 theorems, all with empty axiom reports. LEAN-INDEX never shows the spine as its own group: it is mixed into a "core" group of 275 files whose concept entry is the older GENERATIVE-CORE-LEAN.md chapter.

**Condition.** `make research-check` passes (229 records, 0 errors), but it does not run the other three generators' checks, and those report problems:
- The Lean catalogue is stale by 4 module rows and its JSON.
- The reading catalogue has a stale hash for THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING, so ARGUMENTS-M-Z.md no longer matches its own data.
- The generativity chain is in needs-review with 36 changed sources and 5 new pages.
- SESSION-RESULTS.md has drifted from its renderer.

**Duplication.**
- ROADMAP.md is GOALS.md under another title, plus a history block.
- The same 229-row register table appears in RESULT-REGISTER.md, RESULTS.md, RESEARCH.md, theories/becoming/README.md and CLAIMS.md.

**Navigation.** The reading catalogue's routes ("What foundation has been established?", "How far do mathematical results reach?") send readers to pre-spine chapters. They never point to THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING, even though that chapter says it has replaced those chapters as entry points.

**The generativity chain.** Ren asked for it on 8 October ("keep it updated"). Its 30 Formal-support entries link no spine Lean file, and the whole chain never mentions Part I or the no-premise laws. Its entry C03 says G0 is no longer an axiom, while C17 still presents adopting G0 as an axiom as the route. Entries have grown into append-only logs: M20 alone runs to 44k characters and 222 links. Because it fingerprints generated pages, every landing makes it drift, and R18 P8 found 8 landings that refreshed fingerprints with no recorded reading.

**Restructure.** Most of the gain comes from retiring duplicates and dated snapshots, not from moving files:
- Turn ROADMAP into a stub pointing to GOALS.
- Keep one register, grouped by layer.
- Move SESSION-RESULTS to history.
- Rewrite the results README as a current landing page.
- Re-index the Lean catalogue with spine, bridge and older groups.
- Compact lean-index.json and mark it as generated so landing diffs stop churning.
- With Ren, rewrite the chain to cover the spine and shrink its scope logs.
- Add all of these generator checks to research-check.

Keep current paths, because 12–15 documents link into these views.

areas.summary:
These 19 files sit in experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/. Together they hold about 13,200 lines and 1,071 theorems. check_becoming.py places 17 of them in CORE and GranularityBridge in BRIDGE. FallibleInquiry is in neither list. It is a periphery adapter with its own checker (check_fallible_inquiry.py), even though it sits in the core folder.

**Imports and purity.** Every CORE module imports only Becoming.* or GenerativeCore. Frame is the root and imports GenerativeCore only. GranularityBridge imports the periphery modules ExplanatoryResiduals and ExplanatoryGranularityBoundary, which the bridge layer allows. FallibleInquiry imports ScientificInquiryNecessity from inquiry-root.
- None of the 19 files contains sorry, admit, axiom, opaque, unsafe, implemented_by, native_decide, maxHeartbeats or Classical. Excluded middle, Markov's principle, LPO and RecursOrStops appear only as named hypotheses or as targets of calibration theorems.
- The latest core receipt (becoming-verification.json, run 20261016T124157.989030Z, status passed) gives an empty axiom-dependency map for every declaration of the 18 spine modules here. Every one of the 135 record proof_bindings to these modules matches the current source sha256.
- FallibleInquiry's own receipt (20261016T120403) shows 17 of its 37 declarations depending on propext and Quot.sound. That periphery checker allows them.

**Substance.**
- *Substantive, constructive results:*
  - Gluing: GF(2) elimination, i.e. parity contextuality glues exactly where no selection of contexts contradicts.
  - Horizon: refutability of test readings is equivalent to Markov's principle; a finite prefix cannot decide the renewing/consuming class.
  - Gated: the origin law is equivalent to double-negation elimination.
  - Granularity: reading a recipe as one test is exact for every frame exactly under excluded middle; the Midway loss.
  - Frequency: carried ≤ D(1+M)^a, attained by a self-loop; the sparse loop recurs yet stays polynomial; settling of every schedule is equivalent to the Σ⁰₂ dichotomy and gives LPO.
  - Entropy: pigeonhole over the configurations within a stock gives no_arrow and forgets.
  - Histories: splice-closure, dead ends, and the Choosing example where traces do not fix bisimulation.
  - Experiment: untaken moves are not fixed; the confound witness.
  - Feeding: exact conditions under which a need is met.
- *Definitional or bookkeeping statements presented as "no premise" results:*
  - Flow.history_mono: a running sum of naturals never shrinks.
  - Gain.rise_netGiver: the rest is defined as the residual, so every rise is "given" by construction.
  - Experiment.Run.fixes_of_takes: unfolds the definition.
  - Evolution.price: an arithmetic identity, honestly labelled as such.
  - transmitted_supported: its content lies in the TransmitsWithin premise.
  - Generation.dissipation_generation_not_recurring: plain descent on Nat.
- *Wrapper modules:* FormedLoops and FinerTraces are instance modules. Their records state this ("application, not a new result").

**Documentation.** Module headers are unusually candid: each has a "What is not derived" list, AI readings are labelled with the DELEGATED-CHOICES item that adopted them, and Ren's quotes are attributed. The main problems are elsewhere:
1. Frequency's headline reading, that how fast a difference runs away is set by how often couplings act and not by how strong they are, is an artifact of natural-number strengths. Because a positive strength is at least 1, every return at least doubles. The chapter summary rows repeat the reading without that condition.
2. The chapter §9 module table (hand-maintained) has stale theorem counts for 18 modules. In this area: Flow 77 vs 97, Horizon 34 vs 37, Evolution 25 vs 31. The table also omits the six P130 core modules, including FinerTraces and FormedLoops.
3. FallibleInquiry has non-empty axiom reports but lives in the core folder under the Becoming namespace, and no README or chapter entry explains this.

**Smaller issues.** Constructive double-negation conclusions are described as positive in prose. Some names are inexact (Depletes, agrees_iff_even, a `Feedback` namespace inside Horizon.lean). One periphery witness has a reflexive conjunct. About 10 list/Nat helper lemmas are reproved in several modules.

**Evidence store.** The receipt folder becoming-checks/ is a large cleanup target: 171 runs, 31,786 tracked files including 13,817 copied .lean files, about 446 MB on disk. Current records bind only 36 of these runs.

issues.title: 'Runaway is set by frequency, not strength' is an artifact of natural-number strengths
issues.description: The header (L11–12, bold bullet L26), the chapter body, the chapter summary and the §9 table present 'how fast is fixed by how often couplings act, not by how strong they are' as the reading of the result. The doubling in carried_doubles_return holds only because a positive Nat strength is at least 1. With real strengths below 1, which is the usual damped case, returns can shrink a difference and strength decides runaway. The header's 'What is not derived' and the record statement ('with natural-number strengths') carry the caveat. The chapter summary row (L1297) and table row (L1648) state 'whatever the strengths' without it.
issues.evidence: Frequency.lean:11-12, :26, :430 (carried_doubles_return); theories/becoming/chapters/THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md:509 (reading 'strength changing only how large'), :1297, :1648; record how-often-couplings-act.json statement includes 'with natural-number strengths'
issues.fix: Qualify the bold reading and the chapter summary and table rows: 'with natural-number strengths (each positive strength ≥ 1)'. Present 'frequency not strength' as a property of the discrete representation, not of loops in general. The reading is already marked pending Ren; raise it with Ren.
issues.verify_reason: The caveat is real but most of the cited places already carry it. In Lean, carried_doubles_return (Frequency.lean:430) works over Nat, so any coupling has strength at least 1 and the doubling follows from that. Frequency is a discrete-representation property, not a law of loops in general. The module header itself qualifies the claim at L30-31: 'Strengths are natural numbers, so a positive strength is at least one; with strengths below one the doubling does not follow.' The chapter body at L509 also qualifies it ('a positive strength being at least one'), and its 'Not derived' list names real amounts and shrinking strengths. The record statement says 'with natural-number strengths'. Only three places drop the qualifier: the opening sentence L11-12, the summary bullet L1297 ('every return at least doubles it, frequent returns make it run away') and the §9 table row L1648. The phrase 'whatever the strengths' in L1297 and L1648 belongs to carried_le_of_rare (the polynomial upper bound when coupling steps are rare). That part holds independently of strength size, with degree n*M, so it is not an overclaim. The unqualified part is only the doubling and runaway clause. This is local summary wording, so minor rather than major.
issues.corrected_fix: Add '(natural-number strengths, so each positive strength is at least 1)' to the doubling and runaway clause only, in THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md L1297 and L1648 and in the opening sentence at Frequency.lean L11-12. Keep 'whatever the strengths' on the carried_le_of_rare clause. These are AI-written summaries, so the wording can change without Ren. The interpretive reading 'strength changing only how large' is the AI's and is still pending Ren, so raise it with Ren when the readings are reviewed.

issues.title: Receipt store holds 31,786 tracked files (13,817 .lean copies, 446 MB) across 171 runs
issues.description: Each retained run copies sources and logs. Current records bind only 36 runs. The rest survive as evidence referenced from studies and history, but they dominate the repository's file count.
issues.evidence: git ls-files becoming-checks | wc -l → 31786; git ls-files becoming-checks | grep -c '\.lean$' → 13817; du -sh becoming-checks → 446M; 36 run ids appear in records' proof_bindings; 166 of 171 are referenced somewhere in tracked text
issues.fix: Do not delete. Pack runs not bound by current records into per-month archives under a history location, with a manifest of sha256 values and original paths. Keep a redirect index so existing links to run ids still resolve. Requires Ren's approval.
issues.verify_reason: The numbers hold. becoming-checks has 31,786 tracked files, 13,817 of them .lean, uses 446M on disk and holds 171 runs. That is about 45% of the repo's 70,495 tracked files, a very large file-count win. Some details are off. Records mention 45 distinct run ids by string match, not 36 (36 may be the proof_bindings subset). Newer runs already keep only changed copies: the latest run copies 6 modules plus Becoming.lean and the checker. Other '-checks/' directories add another 16,293 tracked files, so the problem is wider than this one folder. The proposed fix is risky. Packing runs into per-month tar archives changes the original bytes, which conflicts with AGENTS.md ('Preserve original bytes', 'Do not import ... redundant export archives'). Moving folders also breaks every run path cited in studies, records, receipts (retained_run) and inherited-receipt bindings. And because git history keeps everything, neither move nor pack reduces repository size, only working-tree file count.
issues.corrected_fix: Do not tar the runs or rewrite their bytes. With Ren's approval, git mv the run folders that no current record binds into a history location such as becoming-checks-history/<run-id>/, keeping each folder's bytes intact. Add a generated index there mapping each run id to its old path, its commit, and every document that cites it. Then rewrite links in studies and records by script, and run make research-check and link verification. Keep every run bound by a current record's proof_bindings, the current receipt's retained_run and inherited receipts where they are. Apply the same treatment to the other *-checks/ trees. Alternatively, leave the bytes in place and only exclude these folders from catalogue and navigation views, which gets the navigation benefit at no risk.

areas.summary:
This area holds 15 modules: 13 core modules and 2 bridge modules (Becoming.Instances and Becoming.JoiningBridge), all under experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/. Together they have 13,604 lines and 820 theorems, counted with comments removed. The bridge modules sit in check_becoming.py BRIDGE (line 82); their imports of periphery modules such as WisdomResponseStructure and ExplanatoryJoiningBranches are allowed there. Every core module imports only Becoming.* modules or InquirySufficiency.

Purity holds. In code (outside comments) there is no sorry, admit, axiom, opaque, unsafe, implemented_by, native_decide, maxHeartbeats or Classical. The only `decide` uses are the kernel tactic, in Joint and Instances. The latest receipt, becoming-checks/20261016T124157.989030Z, has status passed and an empty core axiom report. Its per-module reports for all 15 modules are []. The bridge audit flags only Becoming.RepairComparison.State.mk.injEq. I recomputed the sha256 of all 15 sources and each matches the receipt, so the receipt covers the current bytes.

Content falls into four tiers:
(a) Substantive, often reverse-mathematics, results:
- Identification: exact bounded-record lengths N+N'−1; the 2N−1 optimal rest step with no bound given; cubic rest of the refutation learner; Moore's N−1 with no decision.
- Likeness: a constructive Hennessy–Milner theorem for finite decided frames; branching tests fixing likeness, equivalent to excluded middle or to LLPO for decided families.
- Lasting: ladders and funnels; LPO and LLPO boundaries; the fan.
- Keeping: plans exist exactly under choice (plans_iff_choice).
- Learning: the diagonal argument and Gold-style refutation-learner bounds.
(b) Correct but elementary laws with witnesses: Identity (pigeonhole forcing of arising, census balance), Joint (but-for difference-making), Joining (bisimulation and open maps), Interdependence (unfed consumption ends).
(c) Near-definitional wrappers: Inquiry; Imbalance (slack-variable equivalence); Learning's lumping and training lemmas; Interdependence.bounded_whole, which is `fun _ => trivial`.
(d) Transport: LearnableRuns restates Learnable along runs.

Most docstrings are careful and say what is a hypothesis, including EM, LLPO, choice and "given the world".

Problems found:
- Canonical prose over-reads Learning. "The uniformity of nature is no premise" conflicts with the positive theorems, each of which takes a uniformity-type hypothesis.
- The chapter §9 module table is hand-maintained and stale: three theorem counts are wrong, and the six P130 modules, LearnableRuns among them, are missing.
- LearnableRuns redefines Parting.course and RightAt instead of reusing them.
- Module descriptions are repeated in five places. Those five are the module headers, the 1,139-line comment in the root Becoming.lean, the package README table, the chapter §9 table and LEAN-INDEX. They have already drifted apart.
- Several records' evidence prose names old receipts as binding "current bytes".
- Minor: attribution (Fine–Wilf, Ishihara), naming (a homonymous statesBelow_shift with the converse statement in Parting, the `decide` binder name, a section named `Governance`), helper lemmas duplicated across modules, and the Imbalance adoption provenance.

For restructuring, the main wins are:
- generating the chapter table and the root catalogue from lean-index.json;
- rebasing LearnableRuns on Parting, or folding it into Learnable;
- refreshing record evidence to the latest receipt;
- moving the 171 receipt folders (446 MB, 31,786 tracked files) to an archive tier with a manifest.

issues.title: 'The uniformity of nature is no premise' contradicts the hypotheses of the positive learning theorems
issues.description: The Learning header (Readings, D26) and the canonical chapter both say induction is 'resolved into laws' and that 'the uniformity of nature is no premise: it is the local condition of a law'. But every positive generalization or learning theorem in this area takes exactly such a condition as an explicit hypothesis. lumped_world_right needs `world : Lumped π f`. held_learner_bounded and held_rest_unrefuted need `held : ∀ n, orbit ∈ l`. Learnable.learnable_iff needs `world : ∀ s, s ∈ l`. The negative theorems (no_record_fixes_next, diagonal_unrested, every_determines_nothing) show that without such a condition nothing is learned. The condition is therefore a premise of each theorem, though local. Calling it 'no premise' misstates what is proved, against AGENTS.md's rule to state supplied premises.
issues.evidence: grep -n 'uniformity' experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Learning.lean; theories/becoming/chapters/THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md line 572 ('induction is resolved into laws rather than certified; the uniformity of nature is no premise but the local condition'); Learning.lean lumped_world_right signature `(world : Lumped π f)` (~line 886); held_learner_bounded `(held : ∀ n, Law.orbit next s n ∈ l)` (~line 753)
issues.fix: Reword in the Learning header, the chapter (zh+en) and the wisdom-root records. Suggested: 'uniformity is not a global axiom; it enters as a local, named hypothesis of each positive theorem (Lumped world, a list holding the world), and without it the negative laws hold'. Replace 'induction is resolved' with 'induction is located: what is learnable is fixed exactly by a stated local condition'. Ren to approve, since the reading was adopted on delegation.
issues.verify_reason: The quoted text is there. Learning.lean lines 94-101 (D26 reading) and chapter line 572 both say 'the uniformity of nature is no premise'. The positive theorems do take local hypotheses: lumped_world_right (Learning.lean:886) takes `world : Lumped π f`; held_learner_bounded (753) and held_rest_unrefuted (772) take `held : ∀ n, Law.orbit next s n ∈ l`; Learnable.learnable_iff (Learnable.lean:233) and LearnableRuns.learnable_iff (153) take `world : ∀ s, s ∈ l`. But the prose does not hide these conditions. The same sentence calls uniformity 'the local condition of a law', and the header says 'In every world held by a list ...' and 'rests only there'. The chapter also says induction is resolved 'rather than certified'. The repo uses 'no premise' for 'no theory-level premise beyond what each theorem names' (compare the CourseWorlds README row). So this is ambiguous wording, not an overclaim about what is proved. The finding also merges two different conditions. `held`/`world : ∀ s, s ∈ l` is a finiteness condition; only `Lumped` is the uniformity condition the reading refers to. Severity is minor, not major.
issues.corrected_fix: Clarify, don't reverse. Change 'is no premise' to 'is no premise of the theory: it enters as a named local hypothesis of each positive theorem (`Lumped` for generalization; a list holding the world for bounded refutation), and without it the negative laws hold'. Keep the finiteness condition separate from uniformity. Leave 'resolved into laws rather than certified' alone unless Ren chooses otherwise. This is a D26 reading adopted on Ren's delegation, so the wording change goes to Ren first. issues.title: LearnableRuns redefines notions that Parting already defines
issues.description: LearnableRuns.course (reg) (r : Run (Law.process next)) := fun n => reg (r.state n) is definitionally Parting.course specialized to Law.process. LearnableRuns.RestsFrom restates Parting.RightAt-style claims along a run. Learnable.claim_not_right_on_both parallels Parting.not_right_on_both. P130 landed after P129's 'one notion one definition' pass, and AGENTS.md asks to build on shared definitions rather than parallel ones. There are now three 'course' notions: Learnable.course (orbit), LearnableRuns.course and Parting.course.
issues.evidence: LearnableRuns.lean line 46 `def course (reg : S → R) (r : Run (Law.process next)) : Nat → R := fun n => reg (r.state n)`; Parting.lean line 135 `def course (reg : S → R) (r : Run P) : Nat → R := fun n => reg (r.state n)`; Parting.lean line 152 not_right_on_both; Learnable.lean claim_not_right_on_both
issues.fix: Restate LearnableRuns on Parting.course, and add an instance lemma linking RestsFrom with Parting.RightAt for val = reg. Alternatively fold LearnableRuns into Learnable as a section; Learnable can import Branching without a cycle. Claim on the work board first.
issues.verify_reason: Only the one-line `course` definition is duplicated. LearnableRuns.course (line 47, not 46) is `fun n => reg (r.state n)`, definitionally Parting.course (Parting.lean:135) at P := Law.process next. The rest is not a parallel copy. LearnableRuns.RestsFrom/Rests carry a separate target `val : S → V` and a rest-from-T claim. Parting.RightAt is a one-step claim whose target is the registration itself (pred : List R → Option R), so it is not a restatement. LearnableRuns is explicitly a bridge: record_eq, restsFrom_iff and rests_iff link it to Learnable's orbit notions through Branching.law_run_state, which is the instance/equivalence connection AGENTS.md asks for. Learnable.course (orbit from a configuration) is a different object, also linked by record_eq. LearnableRuns does not import Parting, so reusing Parting.course would add the Distinguishing and Lasting imports. The P129 'one notion one definition' pass is real (commit 57f0041cd), and P130 (0497eb66c) landed after it, so a missed link is a fair note. Folding LearnableRuns into Learnable is unnecessary churn.

areas.summary:
This area holds the canonical result register for the Theory of Becoming, ids a to l: 123 records, each a JSON source plus a rendered MD view. Of these, 116 are theorem/recorded-checked, 5 are assessment/reviewed-scoped and 2 are argument/reviewed-scoped. Schema 1 covers 63 records (claim and limitations) and schema 2 covers 60 (statement, laws, does_not_show, standard_boundaries, text_versions). The JSON totals 6.7 MB and the MD 6.0 MB; the whole records directory is 23 MB.

**Canonical sources**
- 72 records cite the pure-core spine (Becoming/*.lean).
- 44 cite periphery Lean (deeper/, inquiry-root/, universal-ethics/, market-generativity/, GenerativeCore). Most of these 44 also cite a spine restatement through Bridge, CompositionBridge, JoiningBridge, Courses, Likeness and others.
- 7 cite Markdown.

**Mathematical condition: sound**
- `research.py check` reports 0 errors and 0 drift. Every Lean alias I indexed (302) exists: 225 in the spine and 77 in periphery source.
- I compared 35 or more headline claims with the Lean statements. The laws match the declarations.
- Receipt 20261016T124157.989030Z (status passed, 215 modules, 6,918 core theorems) matches the bytes of all 136 current spine modules. The fresh I5 run today also passed (703 steps, empty core axiom report).
- I found no false theorem.

**Weak points: bookkeeping and wording, not the mathematics**
- Five headlines say more than their Lean statements. The most important: continued-change-needs-openness says "so comes to rest", but the Lean proves only ¬¬∃N (cannot be refuted). becoming-finite-horizon makes a universal claim that is proved in one process.
- Four records carry the "no-evaluation" boundary although their laws state significance or G0 predicates.
- Nine records were corrected under the eighteenth review but still say "not independently reviewed" and still ask for a review.
- The hub record laws-of-one-step still lists finer units, coarser steps and continuous time as untested, although Units, Sampling and Tower landed on 10-12.
- validation_scope prose has drifted from proof_bindings: 17 records name no bound receipt and about 40 are partial. 21 records cite proof files that have no binding.
- Family tags are misleading. F07 ("Practical judgment and alignment") holds 12 records labelled no-ethical-premise, among them the Part I loops and propagation results.
- About 32 dependency edges are shared-definition reuse rather than inference. Example: 12 records "depend" on more-needs-renewers for `count`/`Distinct`.

**Bloat**
- 62% of the 4,283 history entries are mechanical notes such as "rebound/rehashed, claim unchanged".
- Boilerplate next_delta and validation_scope text is copied across families: F22 ×7, F09 ×4, census ×3.
- Periphery micro-records (F22 joining ×7, F02 jointness ×5, branching ×2) could become family records with their aliases kept.

**Honest labelling**
Several "theorems" are definitional or standard, and the proved list should say so: consumed_iff, paths_comparison_widens, drawn_iff_not_returns, the price identity, beyond_gives_nothing, trace_map, every_selection_within_iff_total_within and derivation_sound.

**Families, A to I**
- A. counting, census and rest
- B. laws of one step and scale
- C. unfolding structure, likeness, law and history
- D. learning, identification and experiment
- E. response, propagation and loops
- F. parts, regions and the conditional axiom (§6.15)
- G. bridges
- H. periphery results migrated on 10-08
- I. assessments and arguments

**Recommended cleanup** (all loss-free)
- Rebind spine proof references to the one current receipt.
- Generate the receipt sentence of validation_scope from proof_bindings.
- Compress the mechanical history into a generated binding log, keeping the originals in text_versions and history.
- Re-tag the families.
- Fix the stale and overclaiming text.

No record should be deleted.

issues.title: Universal headline for a result proved in one process

issues.verify_reason: The headline quantifies over every finite history of every process. The Lean gives, in two specific processes (Becoming.Renewable without feedback and Becoming.Feedback's support-gated law), for every horizon h a pair of runs that agree before h and differ in classification. That establishes 'no prefix-decided reading is exact' within those processes, not 'every finite history leaves it open'. Even inside the renewable process, not every prefix of every run is undecided. The finding says the theorem is in 'the Renewable process with the feedback law', which is slightly off: the two processes are separate. Its core point holds, and the record's own does_not_show line 90 says 'Proved once in the renewable process without feedback and once in the support-gated law with feedback'.
issues.corrected_fix: Headline: 'In the renewable process, with or without feedback, no reading fixed by a finite prefix decides whether drawing renews or consumes: for every horizon two runs agree before it and differ.' issues.title: 'no-evaluation' boundary on records whose laws state significance or G0 predicates
issues.description: The standard boundary no-evaluation means 'contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing'. Four records carry it while their laws state Web.Retains or significance ('as the axiom does'), Becoming.Unrestricted, Mutualism.significant_iff ('G0 there is exactly a seed…') or Valuation.significant_iff. no-ethical-premise is defensible for an equivalence; no-evaluation is false.
issues.evidence: comparison-within-reach.json:179; levels-of-closure.json:183; life-as-condition-of-life.json:280; living-on-and-descent.json:193; definition in theories/becoming/results/data/standard-boundaries.json
issues.fix: Remove no-evaluation from these four, or replace it with a boundary saying the result relates an evaluation to structure without asserting it. Consider a registry check that flags no-evaluation where the declarations include significant, Retains, Unrestricted or G0.
issues.verify_reason: standard-boundaries.json defines no-evaluation as 'Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing'. Its note says to cite a key only where the sentence is true. The laws of the four records are about significance, which Becoming/Significance.lean presents as the one axiom, the condition of §6.15. They use Web.Retains and Web.Adds, 'under the axiom', Becoming.Unrestricted (levels-of-closure), Mutualism.significant_iff (life-as-condition-of-life) and 'G0 there is exactly a seed' via Valuation.significant_iff (living-on-and-descent). Those are evaluative predicates, used conditionally. Under the P128 fold this mislabels §6.15-conditional content as evaluation-free. comparison-where-the-rest-responds (also F07) carries the same boundary and may share the problem.
issues.corrected_fix: Remove no-evaluation from these records, after also checking comparison-where-the-rest-responds and other records whose laws cite Retains, Adds, Unrestricted or significant_iff. Where it fits, add a boundary such as 'relates a significance or the §6.15 condition to structure without asserting it'. A registry check that flags no-evaluation alongside those declarations is reasonable.

areas.summary:
These twelve modules hold 14,748 lines and 1,082 theorems: OneStep 311, Order 266, Loops 113, Listing 85, Openness 85, Locality 44, Metaethics 40, LossMatching 34, Mechanism 30, Onward 28, Observation 27 and Novelty 19. They are part of the pure core of the Becoming spine. Eleven of them state Part I laws about change with no premise beyond what each theorem names: one-step laws and their completeness, rest and openness, identity among what is listed, the order of exchanges as the time invariant, carried differences and loops, observation as a route of readings, runs without selection, and returning, novelty and forgetting. Metaethics states the G0 characterization and its minimality countermodels on the same frame. LossMatching gives the general laws of strict loss matching used by RepairComparison.

Purity and checking. No module contains sorry, admit, axiom, opaque, unsafe, implemented_by, native_decide, maxHeartbeats, set_option or Classical in its code. Those words appear only in docstrings ("Classical sources", "no axiom occurs"). No module uses omega or simp. Each imports only Becoming.* modules, and its transitive closure reaches only GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency and RelationalRenewal. Two kept receipts cover all twelve modules: becoming-checks/20261016T121942.514802Z and 20261016T124157.989030Z. In both the status is "passed", every module is kernel_checked, its axiom_dependencies are empty, and its source sha256 matches the current file. The only generated axiom dependencies are six `injEq` lemmas on propext in OneStep (Witness.Place, Chain.Site, Witness.Part, Chain.Relatum). These are generated by Lean, not written in the source. All 77 record proof-bindings into these modules match current hashes. Every backticked identifier in the module docstrings resolves to a declaration or namespace.

Substance. Most headline theorems are real results:
- OneStep's exact realizability theorems, proved by constructing witness worlds.
- Order's commutation results, a formal Mazurkiewicz trace theorem (`Footprinted.sorts_iff`, `Footprinted.converse`).
- Loops' characterizations "finite order exact ⇔ no upstream loop" and "polynomial ⇔ no upstream loop".
- Observation's noninterference theorem (`apart_only_downstream`).
- Onward's equivalence with dependent choice and its finite-lasso runs built without choice.
- Listing's equivalences with excluded middle.
- LossMatching's counting law.

Several are elementary or close to definitional, and their prose mostly says so: Metaethics.significant_iff, Mechanism.carries_law_iff (the image is the least factorization), LossMatching.readsAt_iff_settled, Locality's comesToStand_iff/ceasesToStand_iff, and OneStep.laws (a logical corollary).

Main problems:
1. The canonical chapter claims too much about Onward. In its "Further proofs" list it says "a run from every configuration that can move is given" (zh line 1495, en line 1508). Onward proves this only within finitely many configurations or for searched moves; asked of every process it is exactly dependent choice.
2. The Part I modules Loops, Observation and Onward transitively import Becoming.Significance (the §6.15 condition) and Metaethics, through Testing → Feedback → Interdependence. They use no ethical definition. Still, the import graph and the README's L4 layer blur the Part I/Part II separation the theory claims.
3. Some headline statements are restated with identical types as "instances": Openness/Space/Decidedness `arising_iff_ceasing` (three copies), Openness/Space rest, and Loops/Remainder. Many list and arithmetic utility lemmas are duplicated across modules: 23 groups of identical types involve these modules. This inflates theorem counts.
4. There is wording drift: the OneStep title "all the laws" reads against the one-step-missing-laws record, plus a P128 search-replace artifact, review-history provenance in docstrings, and very long module headers that repeat the README and chapter.

proved.claim: Laws of one step are characterized exactly: a pattern of passages on a family is shown by some world across some step exactly when it obeys the law of every step (takers at least sign of uptake, at most uptake; exchange where anything is taken or given), and each local condition (balance, running down, closure, both) adds exactly its stated law; the same for runs on one family (plus chaining), givers, capacity (one law) and activity (no law).

The module title 'the laws of one step are all the laws of one step' is ambiguous: its own section (runsDownClosed_iff_stated, stated_not_realized, standing_bound_needed) shows Locality's stated laws missed two laws.

proved.claim: Running down, local form: across a step at which a family holding what stands is balanced and dissipated on, some standing changes exactly when the family total falls; closed as well, something exchanges exactly then; under a census of what stands, change recurs exactly where it recurs at steps that do not run down; running down bounds change over a stretch.

proved.claim: Ceasing needs arising (cohort law): for any finite list, what holds at the end plus ceasings over a stretch equals what held at the start exactly when nothing on it comes to be; with a covering list and nothing coming to be from N on, ceasing does not recur, with no decidability.
proved.conditions: Decidable determination for the counting forms; none for the Covers/¬¬ forms.

proved.claim: Rest beyond finite worlds: with a census of what stands, embodied arising, balance, dissipation and enclosure around what stands from some step on (and a census of activity), that the world rests from some step on cannot be refuted; the exchange does not recur; each premise is needed (witness worlds); a bounded activity count keeps arising and ceasing together, an unboundedly growing bound does not; listing every member that ever holds gives LPO.
proved.conditions: Stated conclusions are double-negated (¬¬∃ N, RestsFrom N); naming the step is LPO (World.lpo_of_finite_ends, elsewhere).
proved.assessment: Substantive constructive results with independence witnesses. World.Finite.arising_iff_ceasing and World.Finite.comes_to_rest_unrefuted have exactly the types of Space's World.arising_iff_ceasing and World.rests_unrefuted (restatements as cases).

proved.claim: Time is read off change: reading through a stuttering preserves all premises, stretch totals and recurrence; idle steps can be removed; commuting exchanges not joined (relative to a containing footprint) preserves every premise and the partial order Precedes, and the renumberings so reached are exactly those keeping the order of joined exchanges (Mazurkiewicz); Reorders without the footprint condition breaks dependence (Crossing) or acting (Arising).
proved.conditions: stutter_premises_iff needs DecidableEq on relata and w.flow.Once; footprint given and decided (Contains); sides of Reorders given.
proved.assessment: Substantive; a formal trace-equivalence theorem. Prose matches, including the stated limits (footprint not derived).

proved.claim: How a carried difference grows: order j of the carried amount is exact up to step j; with every condition listed and couplings holding always, a finite order is exact from every start exactly where no loop lies upstream; with stationary natural strengths the carried amount is polynomially bounded exactly where no loop lies upstream, and every loop at least doubles per turn; bounds D·Σ binom·M^i and D(1+M)^t are attained by a self-loop; via most_difference_arrives these hold of the most difference that can arrive over all laws.
proved.conditions: Strengths are natural numbers (so doubling); stationary strengths and constant formations for the polynomial equivalence; part gives no gap after start.
proved.assessment: Substantive combinatorics (nilpotency/Neumann-series analogues). 'Runaway' is about the bound (most difference that can arrive), as the readings say. Remainder restates carriedWithin_exact, carriedWithin_exact_of_no_loop and Once.exact with identical types.

proved.claim: Observation lies within the downstream (noninterference): for every exchange law reading into each condition a schedule, two balanced courses with the same formations present, the part acting alike and the rest following the law, apart at the start only at stock c, agree at every condition not downstream of c by the readings formed by that step; routes form by closing; a measurement witness forms the route and loop at T.
proved.conditions: ReadsInto schedule with listed levels; balanced flows; same present formations; part acts alike.
proved.assessment: Substantive one-direction result. The prose states honestly that downstream does not imply registering. Readings pending Ren.

proved.claim: Where a run goes on: within finitely many configurations a run starts exactly where a course as long as the list does, where courses of every length do, and where a course leads to a return, without decision or selection; with listed successors this is decided; infinite branching (fan) breaks it; searched moves build runs as data; runs from every family that keeps moving, for every process at Type 0, are equivalent to dependent choice.
proved.conditions: Finite list of all configurations for the lasso forms; Finds/enumeration for searched runs; S A : Type for runs_iff_selection.
proved.assessment: Substantive and constructive. The chapter's 'Further proofs' bullet overstates it as 'a run from every configuration that can move is given'.

proved.claim: Returning, novelty and forgetting on the levels alone: a family whose stock stays within a bound revisits a configuration from every step; one new at each of N+1 steps exceeds the bound K, with a bounded search; a bounded family cannot carry a never-repeating record or an unbounded count, so it cannot carry its exchange history (nor can a finite whole); losing at each change bounds the number of changes by the initial stock; Entropy's first-law forms are cases.
proved.conditions: A stated bound or non-rising or loss-per-change condition on the part; discrete steps, natural amounts.
proved.assessment: Correct pigeonhole and potential arguments, elementary but cleanly general. The reading that novelty's gain 'must come from beyond the part' is not proved here (the Gain module carries that).

proved.claim: Listing once is decided identity: a list can be listed without repetition exactly where identity among its members is decided (Decided = P ∨ ¬P); this is never refuted; refutation laws need no listing premise; asked of every world, deciding relational indiscernibility, or fixing every list's count up to indiscernibility, is equivalent to excluded middle; reading taking part by occurrence lists every flow once and keeps amounts and local laws.
proved.conditions: none beyond the representation
proved.assessment: Correct. The core equivalences are elementary list facts. The excluded-middle equivalences use a simple probe-world encoding and are informative reverse-mathematics statements. Prose matches.

proved.claim: Strict loss matching: composes and is monotone; a generative extension is a match by identity, so sufficiency of matching contains comparison principle C; with losses listed once a match needs strictly more losses (irreflexive, asymmetric); counting law: with content read as a class, a match exists exactly when class counts are ≤ and the total is <; infinitely many losses allow a self-match.
proved.conditions: Supplied content relation `same`/class κ, DecidableEq C for the counting law; Le appears only as a hypothesis.
proved.assessment: Counting law substantive (greedy matching proof). readsAt_iff_settled is trivial (support := realized). Header claim 'not conversely' (C does not give sufficiency) has no Lean witness.

proved.claim: Projection carrying a law: some determined process on a description admits every step read through π exactly when configurations alike under π go alike (GoAlike); through id this is determinacy; DependsOnlyOn re-absorbs differences in one step; an adaptive system's state has its own law exactly where the rule makes no difference; standard x_{t+1}=F(x_t,u_t,ε_t) models are determined processes, interventions are moves not taken, and noise forgotten keeps determinacy exactly where it makes no difference.
proved.conditions: none beyond the representation
proved.assessment: Correct but near-definitional: Image is the least factorization, so carries_law_iff is the quotient lemma. GoAlike quantifies over all configurations, reachable or not. Useful as precise definitions; the readings (emergence, interventions) are interpretation.

proved.claim: G0 characterization: on a connected valuation with some living claim, 'every living claim is significant from every standpoint' iff a seed plus N_rel and N_std; dropping seed, N_rel, N_std, connection or A each has a consistent countermodel; a sound inquiry with novel living content gives every position with access a contributory reason under Grounds and A; a natural-number score satisfying C climbs along extension chains.
proved.conditions: Normative premises (seed/S0, N_rel, N_std, A, C) appear as named hypotheses; connection is supplied; living and related are inputs of a Valuation.
proved.assessment: Lean-checked core with empty axiom reports, but normatively conditional. significant_iff is an easy invariance argument (the header admits the forward direction is near-immediate; the backward direction is three lines). The minimality countermodels are the informative part. Nothing proves S0, N, A, C, L or J, as the header says.

issues.title: Chapter says a run from every configuration that can move 'is given'; Onward proves this only in restricted cases and shows the general case is dependent choice
issues.description: The 'Further proofs' list says 'a run from every configuration that can move is given (`Becoming.Onward`: ...; asked of every process it is exactly dependent choice)'. The zh line 1495 says the same: '从每个能动的配置出发的运行已给出'. Onward gives runs only within finitely many configurations (run_iff_continues etc.) or where a test recognizes enumerated moves (searchedRun). In general, runs from every family that keeps moving are equivalent to DependentSelection (runs_iff_selection), which the core does not assume (Onward header lines 55-56). Read literally, the opening clause asserts what the module proves is not given.
issues.evidence: sed -n '1495p;1508p' theories/becoming/chapters/THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md; Onward.lean lines 43-45, 55-58, 396-398 (runs_iff_selection)
issues.fix: Reword both lines, for example: 'where a run goes on: within finitely many configurations, or where moves are searched, a run is given with no selection; asked of every process, a run from every configuration that can move is exactly dependent choice (`Becoming.Onward`)'.
issues.verify_reason: The opening clause does overclaim. Read literally, 'a run from every configuration that can move is given' (en line 1508) and '从每个能动的配置出发的运行已给出' (zh line 1495) assert something Onward does not prove. Onward gives runs only within finitely many configurations (run_iff_continues, run_iff_returning, KeepsMoving.run) or where a Finds test searches enumerated moves (searchedRun). For every process, runs from every family that keeps moving are equivalent to DependentSelection (runs_iff_selection, line 396), which the core does not assume (header lines 43-45, 55-58). However, the parenthetical in the same sentence states exactly these restrictions, ending 'asked of every process it is exactly dependent choice'. A careful reader is therefore not misled, so this is a wording problem, not a claim that misrepresents what is proved. The line is AI-written chapter prose, not Ren's own text, so it can be edited without Ren. The chapter's own heading at line 245, 'Where a run goes on (Part I)', already uses the accurate framing.

issues.title: Part I modules Loops, Observation and Onward import the Part II modules Significance and Metaethics
issues.description: The chapter labels Loops, Observation and Onward '(Part I)' and their headers say no ethical predicate, ranking or axiom occurs. Their import closures nevertheless contain Becoming.Significance (the module stating the one axiom, now the unasserted condition of §6.15) and Becoming.Metaethics. Loops → Propagation → Counterfactual → Response → Testing → Feedback → Interdependence → Significance. Observation → Thresholds → Runaway → Testing → … → Significance. Onward → Parting → Distinguishing → Identification → Description → Learning → Selection → Testing → … → Significance. None of the three uses any ethical definition: grep for Unrestricted, Significan, Valuation, living, G0, Comparison or Extension finds nothing. Logically harmless, since `Unrestricted` is a definition and the axiom reports are empty. Structurally it blurs the Part I/Part II separation. The package README places these modules in layer L4, which it describes as the layer with normative premises (README.md lines 113, 131-133).
issues.evidence: Import chain from the `import` lines: Loops.lean:1, Propagation.lean:1, Counterfactual.lean:1, Response.lean:1, Testing.lean:1, Feedback.lean:1 (import Becoming.Interdependence), Interdependence.lean:1 (import Becoming.Significance); grep -cE 'Unrestricted|Significance\.|Valuation' Feedback.lean (8) Testing.lean (0)
issues.fix: Split the neutral parts of Feedback and Interdependence (feeding closure, registration) from their axiom-hypothesis comparisons, so that Testing and everything below it import no Significance or Metaethics. Then re-layer the README so that Part I modules are not in L4. If Ren keeps the current graph, state in the README and chapter §9 that Part I modules may import Part II definitions without using them.
issues.verify_reason: The core claim holds and is understated. The import chain is as cited: Loops→Propagation→Counterfactual→Response→Testing→Feedback→Interdependence→Significance, and Significance's closure includes Metaethics. Loops, Onward and Observation contain no ethical identifiers (0 matches each for Unrestricted|Significan|Valuation|living|G0|Metaethic), while Feedback has 13 and Interdependence 12. The problem is not limited to those three modules. The root is that Testing (chapter line 529/531, 'Registration and testing (Part I)') imports Feedback, which imports Interdependence, which imports Significance (Interdependence.lean:1). A transitive-closure scan of the 137 modules in Becoming/ finds 49 that import Significance, and with it Metaethics. These include many chapter-labelled Part I modules: Testing, Runaway, Response, Selection, Learning, Description, Identification, Coupling, Onward, Loops and Observation. Unfolding, Locality and Recurrence are clean. The README states 'L1–L3 contain no ethical predicate; every normative premise in L4 is a named definition or hypothesis' (README.md lines 131/133) and places Testing, Feedback, Onward, Propagation, Loops and Observation in L4 (lines 92, 93, 113, 116, 117, 122). So the layer table does not separate Part I from Part II, and the README never says how layer and Part relate. As the finding says, this is logically harmless: Unrestricted is a definition, Part II is now a conditional (P128), and the axiom reports are empty. Severity major is defensible because the Part I/Part II separation is central and a restructure will touch it. A related staleness: README line 89 still says Significance is 'the one axiom, as a condition (Part II asserts it)' / '第二部分断言它'. That conflicts with P128 (d444664e), which folded Part II into the conditional §6.15 so the theory no longer asserts the axiom.
issues.corrected_fix: Two steps, in order. (1) Now, a docs-only change: in the package README layer section (lines 131/133), say that the layers follow the import order, not Part I/Part II. Say that 49 modules, Part I ones among them, import Significance/Metaethics through Testing→Feedback→Interdependence without using any ethical definition, and that a module's Part follows from the declarations it uses. Also fix README line 89 to match P128: Significance states the condition of the conditional §6.15, and the theory does not assert it. (2) Later, a Lean refactor, claimed on _process/BECOMING-WORKBOARD.md and landed through the integrator's queue: move the declarations of Feedback and Interdependence that mention Unrestricted or Significance into a separate bridge module. That module imports Significance plus the neutral Feedback/Interdependence. Keep every declaration's fully qualified name unchanged so records, receipts and catalogue bindings still resolve. Then Testing and everything downstream import no Significance or Metaethics. After that, re-layer the README (for example a Part I layer and a Part II/conditional layer) and add an import-closure check to check_becoming.py so Part I modules cannot regain the dependency. Do not rename or delete modules, and run the checkers with the cache rather than a full rebuild.
